steps.title: Prepare Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Seed neural stem cells (Cor3-1) at a density of 1.5x10^6 in 10 cm dishes with Complete media.
steps.expected_result: Cells are seeded and ready for growth in a suitable environment.

steps.title: Maintain Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Regularly monitor and maintain cells with appropriate growth factors.
steps.expected_result: Cells are healthy and proliferating in culture.

steps.title: Induce Neuronal Differentiation
steps.instruction: Transfer cells to priming and differentiation media to initiate neuronal differentiation.
steps.expected_result: Cells begin to differentiate into neuronal cells.

steps.title: Transfect P19 Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect P19 cells with plasmids using Lipofectamine 2000 according to the manufacturer's instructions.
steps.expected_result: P19 cells are successfully transfected with plasmids.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash cells once with room temperature PBS to remove media.
steps.expected_result: Cells are washed and ready for collection.

steps.title: Collect Cells
steps.instruction: Use a cell scraper to collect cells in ice-cold PBS and transfer to a microcentrifuge tube.
steps.expected_result: Cells are collected in a tube for further processing.

steps.title: Centrifuge to Pellet Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collected cells at 130xg at 4°C for 3 minutes to pellet them.
steps.expected_result: Cell pellet is formed at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Lyse Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Lyse the cell pellet with ice-cold E1 buffer at a ratio of 5 volumes of buffer to 1 volume of pellet.
steps.expected_result: Cell lysate is prepared for fractionation.

steps.title: Centrifuge for Cytoplasm Fraction
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 1,100xg at 4°C for 2 minutes to separate the cytoplasm fraction.
steps.expected_result: Cytoplasm fraction is collected in a fresh tube.

steps.title: Resuspend and Centrifuge for Nucleus Fraction
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in E1 buffer, centrifuge at 1,100xg at 4°C for 2 minutes, and discard supernatant.
steps.expected_result: Nuclear fraction is isolated for further analysis.

steps.title: Prepare for Western Blot
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclear pellet in ice-cold E3 buffer and sonicate for protein extraction.
steps.expected_result: Protein lysate is prepared for Western blot analysis.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the protein lysate at 16,000xg at 4°C for 10 minutes and transfer the supernatant to fresh tubes.
steps.expected_result: Supernatant containing proteins is ready for quantification.

steps.title: Measure Protein Concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the protein concentration using a suitable assay kit and prepare for Western blotting.
steps.expected_result: Protein concentration is determined for subsequent analysis.

steps.title: Prepare for Pull Down Assay
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in ice-cold E3 (benzonase) buffer and detach the pellet by flicking the tube.
steps.expected_result: Pellet is resuspended and ready for benzonase treatment.

steps.title: Add Benzonase and Incubate
steps.instruction: Add benzonase at a 1:1,000 dilution and incubate on a rotating platform at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: Nucleic acids are digested, preparing the sample for pull-down assays.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Collect Supernatant for Pull Down
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 16,000xg at 4°C for 10 minutes and transfer the supernatant to fresh tubes.
steps.expected_result: Supernatant containing proteins is ready for pull-down assays.

steps.title: Submit ethics application
steps.instruction: Prepare and submit the ethics application to the Ethics Reviewing Board.
steps.expected_result: Ethics application is submitted for review.

steps.title: Receive ethics approval
steps.instruction: Await and obtain approval from the Ethics Reviewing Board.
steps.expected_result: Ethics approval is received.

steps.title: Collect biopsy specimens
steps.instruction: Collect lung post-mortem biopsies from COVID-19 and non-COVID-19 patients.
steps.expected_result: Biopsy specimens are collected and ready for processing.

steps.title: Fix and embed tissue samples
steps.instruction: Fix the collected biopsies in 4% formaldehyde for three hours and embed them in paraffin.
steps.expected_result: Tissue samples are fixed and embedded in paraffin.

steps.title: Cut tissue sections
steps.instruction: Use a rotary microtome to cut 4-µm thick sections of the paraffin-embedded tissues.
steps.expected_result: Tissue sections are cut and placed on Superfrost slides.

steps.title: Perform antigen retrieval
steps.instruction: Immerse slides in antigen retrieval buffer and heat in a sterilizer for 10-15 minutes.
steps.expected_result: Antigens are retrieved from the tissue sections.

steps.title: Permeabilize and block samples
steps.instruction: Immerse slides in permeabilization buffer and incubate with blocking buffer for one hour.
steps.expected_result: Samples are permeabilized and blocked to prevent nonspecific binding.

steps.title: Prepare primary staining mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the primary staining mix with specified antibodies in blocking buffer.
steps.expected_result: Primary staining mix is ready for application.

steps.title: Apply primary staining
steps.instruction: Place the primary staining mix on the tissue sections and incubate for one hour.
steps.expected_result: Tissue sections are stained with primary antibodies.

steps.title: Analyze stained samples
steps.instruction: Use fluorescence microscopy to analyze the stained tissue sections.
steps.expected_result: Images of stained samples are acquired for analysis.

steps.title: Quantify NET volume
steps.instruction: Analyze Z-stack images to quantify the volume of NETs in lung tissue.
steps.expected_result: Quantification of NET volume is completed.

steps.title: Perform statistical analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct statistical analyses on the collected data to determine significance.
steps.expected_result: Statistical analysis results are obtained.

steps.title: Prepare germination pots
steps.instruction: Fill pots with 100% vermiculite for germinating tomato seeds.
steps.expected_result: Pots are ready for planting tomato seeds.

steps.title: Germinate tomato seeds
steps.instruction: Plant tomato seeds in prepared pots and place them in a growth room under controlled conditions.
steps.expected_result: Tomato seeds begin to germinate under specified light, temperature, and humidity.

steps.title: Irrigate seedlings
steps.instruction: Irrigate seedlings with distilled water twice a week for one week.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings receive adequate moisture for growth.

steps.title: Apply nutrient solution
steps.instruction: Irrigate seedlings with nutrient solution twice a week for three weeks.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings receive necessary nutrients for optimal growth.

steps.title: Adjust nutrient solution pH
steps.instruction: Adjust the pH of the nutrient solution to 6.0 using KOH.
steps.expected_result: Nutrient solution is at the desired pH for plant uptake.

steps.title: Prepare inhibitor solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve PA biosynthesis inhibitors in water to create the inhibitor solution.
steps.expected_result: Inhibitor solution is ready for application to plants.

steps.title: Divide tomato plants
steps.instruction: Divide 20 uniform tomato plants into two groups: treated and untreated.
steps.expected_result: Two groups of tomato plants are established for treatment comparison.

steps.title: Apply first treatment
steps.instruction: Apply 2 ml of the inhibitor mix to 21-day-old tomato plants by soil drench.
steps.expected_result: Inhibitor mix is applied to the first group of plants.

steps.title: Apply second treatment
steps.instruction: Apply 4 ml of the inhibitor mix to 23-day-old tomato plants by soil drench.
steps.expected_result: Inhibitor mix is applied to the second group of plants.

steps.title: Apply third treatment
steps.instruction: Apply 8 ml of the inhibitor mix to 25-day-old and 27-day-old tomato plants by soil drench.
steps.expected_result: Inhibitor mix is applied to the older group of plants.

steps.title: Collect leaf samples
steps.instruction: Collect the 3rd and 4th true leaves from treated and untreated plants 24 hours after the last treatment.
steps.expected_result: Leaf samples are collected for further analysis.

steps.title: Crush leaf samples
steps.instruction: Crush a pool of 10 plants in liquid nitrogen for putrescine extraction.
steps.expected_result: Leaf samples are homogenized for subsequent analysis.

steps.title: Prepare bacterial suspension
steps.instruction: Culture Pseudomonas syringae and prepare a bacterial suspension for inoculation.
steps.expected_result: Bacterial suspension is ready for inoculating tomato plants.

steps.title: Inoculate tomato plants
steps.instruction: Dip the leaves of tomato plants into the bacterial suspension for inoculation.
steps.expected_result: Tomato plants are inoculated with Pseudomonas syringae.

steps.title: Collect plant tissues
steps.instruction: Collect and dry plant tissues from treated and untreated plants for biomass measurement.
steps.expected_result: Plant tissues are prepared for biomass and chlorophyll analysis.

steps.title: Measure biomass
steps.instruction: Weigh dried plant tissues to determine biomass.
steps.expected_result: Biomass data is obtained for analysis.

steps.title: Measure chlorophyll content
steps.instruction: Analyze dried plant tissues to measure chlorophyll levels.
steps.expected_result: Chlorophyll content data is obtained for analysis.

steps.title: Stain leaves with DAB
steps.instruction: Stain collected leaves with DAB to visualize H2O2 accumulation.
steps.expected_result: Leaves are stained and ready for H2O2 quantification.

steps.title: Quantify H2O2 accumulation
steps.instruction: Use the xylenol orange method to quantify H2O2 levels in stained leaves.
steps.expected_result: H2O2 accumulation data is obtained for analysis.

steps.title: Extract RNA from leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from the collected leaf tissue samples using appropriate methods.
steps.expected_result: RNA samples are prepared for qRT-PCR analysis.

steps.title: Perform qRT-PCR
steps.instruction: Conduct qRT-PCR on extracted RNA to analyze gene expression.
steps.expected_result: Gene expression data is obtained from qRT-PCR results.

steps.title: Inoculate leaves for stomatal analysis
steps.instruction: Inoculate leaves with the appropriate agent for stomatal aperture analysis.
steps.expected_result: Leaves are inoculated and ready for stomatal analysis.

steps.title: Create casts for microscopy
steps.instruction: Create casts of inoculated leaves for stomatal aperture analysis using microscopy.
steps.expected_result: Casts are prepared for microscopic examination.

steps.title: Homogenize fresh tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize fresh tissue samples for chromatographic analysis.
steps.expected_result: Tissue samples are prepared for HPLC analysis.

steps.title: Analyze samples using HPLC
steps.instruction: Analyze hormone and PA samples using HPLC.
steps.expected_result: Chromatographic data is obtained for analysis.

steps.title: Analyze data statistically
steps.instruction: Perform one-way ANOVA on collected data and compare means using statistical tests.
steps.expected_result: Statistical analysis results are obtained.

steps.title: Culture Botrytis cinerea
steps.instruction: Culture Botrytis cinerea for bioassays.
steps.expected_result: Botrytis cinerea is ready for inoculation on tomato plants.

steps.title: Prepare spore suspensions
steps.instruction: Prepare spore suspensions of Botrytis cinerea for inoculation.
steps.expected_result: Spore suspensions are ready for application on tomato plants.

steps.title: Collect leaf tissue samples
steps.instruction: Collect leaf tissue samples from treated and untreated tomato plants.
steps.expected_result: Leaf tissue samples are ready for RNA extraction.

steps.title: Extract RNA using E.Z.N.A. Kit
steps.instruction: Use the E.Z.N.A. Plant RNA Kit to extract RNA from collected leaf tissue samples.
steps.expected_result: RNA samples are prepared for further analysis.

steps.title: Digest RNA with DNase
steps.instruction: Digest 1.5 μg of total RNA with DNase to remove contaminating DNA.
steps.expected_result: RNA is purified and free of contaminating DNA.

steps.title: Inoculate Salmonella cells
steps.instruction: Pick a single colony of Salmonella cells and inoculate it into a glass test tube with LB media, shaking at 150 rpm at 30°C overnight.
steps.expected_result: Overnight culture of Salmonella cells is prepared.

steps.title: Transfer culture to fresh TB
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µl of overnight culture to 5 ml of fresh TB and incubate at 30°C with shaking until the cell density reaches an OD_600 of ca. 1.8.
steps.expected_result: Salmonella cells are grown in fresh TB media.

steps.title: Add ampicillin
steps.instruction: Add ampicillin to the culture at a final concentration of 100 µg/ml after reaching the desired OD.
steps.expected_result: Ampicillin is incorporated into the culture for selection.

steps.title: Prepare cell suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 500 µl of culture to collect cells, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 1.0 ml of motility buffer.
steps.expected_result: Cell suspension in motility buffer is ready for microscopy.

steps.title: Make tunnel slide
steps.instruction: Prepare a tunnel slide by sandwiching double-sided tape between two coverslips.
steps.expected_result: Tunnel slide is ready for cell attachment.

steps.title: Attach cells to slide
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl of the cell suspension to the tunnel slide and leave for 5 minutes to allow attachment.
steps.expected_result: Cells are attached to the coverslip surface.

steps.title: Wash unbound cells
steps.instruction: Wash out unbound cells by adding 100 µl of motility buffer and absorb excess with filter paper.
steps.expected_result: Unbound cells are removed, leaving only attached cells.

steps.title: Set up fluorescence microscope
steps.instruction: Assemble the custom-built fluorescence microscope with the appropriate objective and lens.
steps.expected_result: Fluorescence microscope is set up and ready for imaging.

steps.title: Capture fluorescence images
steps.instruction: Capture images of pHluorin(M153R)-FliG fluorescent spots using the EMCCD camera with a 5 sec exposure time.
steps.expected_result: Fluorescence images of the cells are captured.

steps.title: Measure cytoplasmic pH
steps.instruction: Analyze the captured images to determine the local cytoplasmic pH using fluorescence intensity ratios.
steps.expected_result: Cytoplasmic pH measurements are obtained from the images.

steps.title: Seed LUHMES cells
steps.instruction: Seed proliferative LUHMES cells at 1.5×10^6 per T75 flask.
steps.expected_result: LUHMES cells are seeded and ready for transduction.

steps.title: Transduce LUHMES cells
steps.instruction: Transduce seeded LUHMES cells with GFP-expressing lentiviral particles for 24 hours at an appropriate MOI.
steps.expected_result: LUHMES cells are transduced with GFP, achieving high transduction efficiency.

steps.title: Maintain LUHMES cells
steps.instruction: After transduction, maintain cells in LUHMES Proliferation Media for 72 hours.
steps.expected_result: LUHMES cells are maintained and ready for further experiments.

steps.title: Initiate differentiation
steps.instruction: Change the media from LUHMES Proliferation Media to LUHMES Differentiation Media after 2-3 days of proliferation.
steps.expected_result: LUHMES cells are now in differentiation media.

steps.title: Replate differentiating LUHMES cells
steps.instruction: Replate differentiating LUHMES cells into a 384-well plate after 3 days in differentiation media.
steps.expected_result: LUHMES cells are replated and ready for further analysis.

steps.title: Prepare co-culture
steps.instruction: Seed astrocytes and LUHMES cells in a co-culture setup.
steps.expected_result: Astrocytes and LUHMES cells are co-cultured for assessment.

steps.title: Wash astrocytes
steps.instruction: Wash the astrocytes with sterile PBS to remove media.
steps.expected_result: Astrocytes are washed and ready for lysis.

steps.title: Lyse astrocytes
steps.instruction: Lyse the washed astrocytes to prepare for protein analysis.
steps.expected_result: Astrocyte lysates are prepared for further analysis.

steps.title: Load protein samples
steps.instruction: Load the prepared astrocyte lysates onto SDS-PAGE gels.
steps.expected_result: Protein samples are loaded and ready for electrophoresis.

steps.title: Transfer proteins
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins from the gel to membranes for detection.
steps.expected_result: Proteins are transferred and ready for immunoblotting.

steps.title: Fix cells
steps.instruction: Fix co-cultured cells with appropriate fixative.
steps.expected_result: Cells are fixed and ready for staining.

steps.title: Stain cells
steps.instruction: Stain fixed cells with specific antibodies to visualize target proteins.
steps.expected_result: Cells are stained and ready for imaging.

steps.title: Add MTT solution
steps.instruction: Add MTT solution to the wells to assess cell viability.
steps.expected_result: MTT solution is added and cells are incubated for assessment.

steps.title: Fix and stain for neurite outgrowth
steps.instruction: Fix and stain co-cultures to measure neurite lengths.
steps.expected_result: Neurite outgrowth is visualized and ready for measurement.

steps.title: Sort cells by FACS
steps.instruction: Sort astrocytes and LUHMES cells based on fluorescence and size using FACS.
steps.expected_result: Cells are sorted and collected for further analysis.

steps.title: Process RNA for microarray
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from sorted cells for microarray analysis.
steps.expected_result: RNA is extracted and ready for gene expression analysis.

steps.title: Isolate PBMCs
steps.instruction: Isolate PBMCs from heparinized blood samples using density gradient centrifugation with Ficoll-Hypaque.
steps.expected_result: PBMCs are isolated and ready for further processing.

steps.title: Prepare PBMCs for MACS
steps.instruction: Resuspend isolated PBMCs in 0.5% BSA-PBS buffer and determine the cell number.
steps.expected_result: PBMCs are resuspended and cell number is quantified.

steps.title: Label PBMCs with Microbeads
steps.instruction: Add appropriate Microbeads to the PBMC suspension and incubate.
steps.expected_result: PBMCs are labeled with Microbeads for positive selection.

steps.title: Perform MACS separation
steps.instruction: Use the MACS system to separate CD8+CD28− T cells from the labeled PBMCs.
steps.expected_result: CD8+CD28− T cells are enriched and collected.

steps.title: Culture CD8+CD28− T cells
steps.instruction: Seed CD8+CD28− T cells with B-APCs and cytokines in culture medium.
steps.expected_result: CD8+CD28− T cells are cultured for 9 days.

steps.title: Prepare CFSE-labeled CD4+ T cells
steps.instruction: Isolate and label A-CD4+ T cells with CFSE for proliferation analysis.
steps.expected_result: CFSE-labeled A-CD4+ T cells are ready for coculture.

steps.title: Coculture CD4+ T cells with APCs
steps.instruction: Coculture CFSE-labeled A-CD4+ T cells with B-APCs or I-APCs in the presence or absence of CD8+CD28− T cells.
steps.expected_result: Coculture is established for 7 to 11 days.

steps.title: Analyze CFSE dilution
steps.instruction: Perform flow cytometry to assess CFSE dilution in CD4+ T cells after coculture.
steps.expected_result: Proliferation of CD4+ T cells is quantified based on CFSE dilution.

steps.title: Prepare cell mixture for injection
steps.instruction: Mix responder CD4+ T cells with APCs and in vitro-expanded CD8+CD28− T cells.
steps.expected_result: Cell mixture is prepared for injection into mice.

steps.title: Inject cell mixture into mice
steps.instruction: Administer the cell mixture to NOG mice via intraperitoneal injection.
steps.expected_result: Cells are successfully injected into the mice.

steps.title: Sacrifice mice and isolate spleen
steps.instruction: Sacrifice the mice on day 11 post-injection and isolate the spleen.
steps.expected_result: Spleen is collected for analysis.

steps.title: Analyze CD4+ T cells in spleen
steps.instruction: Process the spleen to obtain a single-cell suspension and analyze CD4+ T cells by flow cytometry.
steps.expected_result: Human CD4+ T cells in the spleen are quantified.

steps.title: Sow seeds
steps.instruction: Sow common bean ‘Black Valentine’ seeds in plastic pots filled with moisted vermiculite, placing the seeds just under the surface.
steps.expected_result: Seeds are sown and covered with vermiculite.

steps.title: Place pots in growth chamber
steps.instruction: Put the pots in a tub full of tap water and place in a growth chamber at 23°C under a 16 h light/8 h dark cycle.
steps.expected_result: Pots are in the growth chamber with appropriate environmental conditions.

steps.title: Water seedlings
steps.instruction: Regularly fill the tub with tap water to maintain capillary watering approximately every two days.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings are adequately watered and growing.

steps.title: Grow seedlings
steps.instruction: Allow seedlings to grow for 10-12 days until primary leaves are fully expanded.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings have developed fully expanded primary leaves.

steps.title: Transplant seedlings
steps.instruction: Transplant three seedlings into a larger pot filled with moisted vermiculite.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings are successfully transplanted into larger pots.

steps.title: Place in dark room
steps.instruction: Place the transplanted pots in a dark room at 19°C for 24 hours before inoculation.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings are acclimatized in the dark room.

steps.title: Prepare DNA plasmid mix
steps.instruction: Mix the appropriate BPMV plasmids in a final volume of 20 µL of 50 mM potassium phosphate buffer in an Eppendorf tube.
steps.expected_result: DNA plasmid mix is prepared for inoculation.

steps.title: Powder leaf with carborundum
steps.instruction: Powder the upper surface of one primary leaf per plant with carborundum.
steps.expected_result: Leaf surface is dusted with carborundum.

steps.title: Apply DNA plasmid mix
steps.instruction: Using a pipetman, place the DNA plasmid mix on the upper leaf surface at the junction between petiole and blade.
steps.expected_result: DNA plasmid mix is applied to the leaf surface.

steps.title: Rub leaf surface
steps.instruction: Rub the leaf surface with a gloved finger to spread the DNA plasmid mix evenly.
steps.expected_result: Leaf surface is evenly rubbed with the DNA plasmid mix.

steps.title: Rinse inoculated leaf
steps.instruction: At 3-4 minutes after rubbing, rinse the inoculated leaf with tap water until all carborundum is removed.
steps.expected_result: Inoculated leaf is rinsed clean of carborundum.

steps.title: Remove excess water
steps.instruction: Gently remove excess water from the upper side of the leaf using absorbent paper.
steps.expected_result: Excess water is absorbed without damaging the leaf.

steps.title: Place inoculated plants in growth chamber
steps.instruction: Place the inoculated plants in a growth chamber at 19°C under a 16 h light/8 h dark cycle.
steps.expected_result: Inoculated plants are in the growth chamber under specified conditions.

steps.title: Examine GFP expression
steps.instruction: Use UV light to examine GFP expression in the primary leaves and capture images with a digital camera.
steps.expected_result: Images of GFP expression are captured.

steps.title: Photograph GFP expression
steps.instruction: Examine GFP expression in aerial organs and roots using a UV lamp and photograph the results.
steps.expected_result: Photographs of GFP expression in various plant parts are obtained.

steps.title: Collect Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Collect blood samples from patients meeting WHO criteria for SARS.
steps.expected_result: 166 blood samples are collected from 41 patients covering acute, convalescent, and recovered phases.

steps.title: Label Samples
steps.instruction: Label each blood sample appropriately for tracking and identification.
steps.expected_result: All samples are labeled and organized for further processing.

steps.title: Clone ACE2 Gene
steps.instruction: Clone the ACE2 gene from a human kidney cDNA library.
steps.expected_result: ACE2 gene is successfully cloned and ready for transfection.

steps.title: Transfect QT6 Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect QT6 cells with the cloned ACE2 gene to create an ACE2-positive cell line.
steps.expected_result: QT6 cells are transfected and selected for ACE2 expression.

steps.title: Seed 293T Cells
steps.instruction: Subculture 293T/17 cells into 6-well plates to achieve 70-90% confluence.
steps.expected_result: 293T cells are seeded and reach the desired confluence by the time of transfection.

steps.title: Prepare Transfection Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the transfection mix by combining plasmid constructs and PEI in Opti-MEM.
steps.expected_result: Transfection mix is prepared and incubated at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfect Cells
steps.instruction: Add the transfection mix dropwise to the 293T cells and swirl gently.
steps.expected_result: Transfection mix is evenly distributed across the cells.

steps.title: Harvest Supernatant
steps.instruction: Harvest the supernatant containing viral pseudotype particles after 48 hours.
steps.expected_result: Supernatant is collected and filtered for downstream applications.

steps.title: Infect Target Cells
steps.instruction: Infect 293T, TE671, and QT6/ACE2 cells with the harvested supernatant.
steps.expected_result: Target cells are infected with the viral supernatant for titer measurement.

steps.title: Heat Inactivate Serum
steps.instruction: Heat patient serum samples at 56°C for 30 minutes to inactivate complement proteins.
steps.expected_result: Serum samples are heat-inactivated and ready for dilution.

steps.title: Dilute Serum Samples
steps.instruction: Perform 2-fold serial dilutions of heat-inactivated serum samples in culture medium.
steps.expected_result: Serum samples are diluted and prepared for mixing with MLV(SARS) virions.

steps.title: Mix Serum with Virions
steps.instruction: Mix diluted serum samples with MLV(SARS) virions at a 1:1 vol/vol ratio.
steps.expected_result: Serum and virions are mixed and ready for incubation.

steps.title: Incubate Mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37°C for 1 hour to allow interaction.
steps.expected_result: Mixture is incubated and prepared for addition to QT6/ACE2 cells.

steps.title: Add Mixture to Cells
steps.instruction: Add 100 μL of the serum-virion mixture to QT6/ACE2 cells seeded at 1 × 10^4 cells per well.
steps.expected_result: QT6/ACE2 cells are treated with the serum-virion mixture.

steps.title: Count GFP-positive Cells
steps.instruction: Count GFP-positive cells 48 hours later using fluorescence microscopy.
steps.expected_result: GFP-positive cells are counted and recorded for analysis.

steps.title: Prepare genomic DNA from ecotypes
steps.instruction: Use standard procedures or the GeneJET Plant Genomic DNA Purification Kit to extract genomic DNA from the ecotypes.
steps.expected_result: Isolated genomic DNA ready for analysis.

steps.title: Cross ecotypes
steps.instruction: Cross ecotypes with short and long telomeres to derive stn1 mutants.
steps.expected_result: Obtained stn1 mutants from the ecotype crosses.

steps.title: Analyze G1 stn1 mutants
steps.instruction: Assess G1 stn1 mutants for growth defects and anaphase bridges.
steps.expected_result: Data on growth defects and anaphase bridges in G1 stn1 mutants.

steps.title: Categorize stn1 mutants
steps.instruction: Divide stn1 mutants into five phenotypic categories based on growth and reproductive traits.
steps.expected_result: Categorized stn1 mutants into phenotypic groups.

steps.title: Quantify severity of telomere dysfunction
steps.instruction: Assess the severity of telomere dysfunction in each phenotypic category.
steps.expected_result: Quantified severity of telomere dysfunction across categories.

steps.title: Prepare samples for dot blot hybridization
steps.instruction: Isolate genomic DNA from G2 and G3 stn1 mutants for dot blot analysis.
steps.expected_result: Genomic DNA samples prepared for hybridization.

steps.title: Perform dot blot hybridization
steps.instruction: Conduct dot blot hybridization to quantify telomeric DNA in the prepared samples.
steps.expected_result: Quantified telomeric DNA levels in G2 and G3 stn1 mutants.

steps.title: Analyze exo1a exo1b stn1 mutants
steps.instruction: Assess developmental defects and fertility in exo1a exo1b stn1 mutants.
steps.expected_result: Data on the impact of EXO1 on stn1 mutants.

steps.title: Compare with stn1 mutants
steps.instruction: Compare the results of exo1a exo1b stn1 mutants with stn1 mutants.
steps.expected_result: Comparison data highlighting differences between the two mutant types.

steps.title: Conduct TRF analysis
steps.instruction: Perform terminal restriction fragment analysis to compare telomere length between stn1 and exo1 stn1 mutants.
steps.expected_result: Data on telomere length and heterogeneity between the two mutant types.

steps.title: Prepare samples for in-gel hybridization
steps.instruction: Isolate genomic DNA from stn1 and exo1 stn1 plants for in-gel hybridization analysis.
steps.expected_result: Genomic DNA samples prepared for in-gel hybridization.

steps.title: Perform in-gel hybridization
steps.instruction: Use in-gel hybridization to measure G-overhang sizes in the prepared samples.
steps.expected_result: Quantified G-overhang sizes in stn1 and exo1 stn1 plants.

steps.title: Generate telomerase-null stn1 mutants
steps.instruction: Create telomerase-null stn1 and exo1 stn1 mutants through appropriate genetic techniques.
steps.expected_result: Obtained telomerase-null stn1 and exo1 stn1 mutants.

steps.title: Collect sibling samples
steps.instruction: Collect samples from siblings of STN1+/− TERT+/− and exo1 STN1+/− TERT+/− parents.
steps.expected_result: Siblings collected for telomere length analysis.

steps.title: Compare telomere lengths
steps.instruction: Analyze and compare telomere lengths among the collected siblings.
steps.expected_result: Data on telomere lengths and any observed shortening.

steps.title: Analyze DNA polymerase α mutants
steps.instruction: Assess plants with hypomorphic mutations in DNA polymerase α for phenotypes and genome stability.
steps.expected_result: Data on phenotypes and genome stability in DNA polymerase α mutants.

steps.title: Measure t-circle abundance
steps.instruction: Perform t-circle amplification assay on DNA polymerase α mutants.
steps.expected_result: Data on t-circle abundance indicating telomere dysfunction.

steps.title: Access TCGA dataset
steps.instruction: Navigate to the TCGA database and select the breast cancer dataset.
steps.expected_result: The TCGA breast cancer dataset is accessed and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Extract mRNA levels
steps.instruction: Extract mRNA levels of MCU and related proteins from the dataset.
steps.expected_result: mRNA levels of MCU and related proteins are collected for analysis.

steps.title: Analyze correlation
steps.instruction: Analyze the correlation of extracted mRNA levels with tumor progression metrics.
steps.expected_result: Correlation analysis results are obtained for further interpretation.

steps.title: Select TNBC models
steps.instruction: Choose different human metastatic TNBC cell lines for the study.
steps.expected_result: Selected TNBC models are ready for experimentation.

steps.title: Prepare agonists
steps.instruction: Prepare specific agonists to assess mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake.
steps.expected_result: Agonists are prepared and ready for application.

steps.title: Assess mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake
steps.instruction: Apply agonists to the selected TNBC models and measure mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake.
steps.expected_result: Data on mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake in response to agonists is collected.

steps.title: Design siRNA
steps.instruction: Design siRNA specific to MCU for silencing in TNBC cell lines.
steps.expected_result: siRNA targeting MCU is designed and ready for transfection.

steps.title: Transfect TNBC cells
steps.instruction: Transfect TNBC cell lines with the designed siRNA to silence MCU expression.
steps.expected_result: MCU expression is successfully silenced in TNBC cell lines.

steps.title: Set up wound healing assay
steps.instruction: Prepare a wound healing assay using MCU-silenced TNBC cell lines.
steps.expected_result: Wound healing assay setup is complete and ready for monitoring.

steps.title: Monitor cell migration
steps.instruction: Monitor and record cell motility in the wound healing assay over time.
steps.expected_result: Data on cell migration in response to MCU silencing is collected.

steps.title: Create 3D collagen matrix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 3D collagen matrix for spheroid formation assay.
steps.expected_result: 3D collagen matrix is ready for cell embedding.

steps.title: Embed MCU-silenced cells
steps.instruction: Embed stable MCU-silenced cells into the 3D collagen matrix.
steps.expected_result: MCU-silenced cells are embedded and ready for invasion assessment.

steps.title: Prepare SCID mice
steps.instruction: Obtain and prepare SCID mice for injection of MCU−/− cells.
steps.expected_result: SCID mice are ready for the injection procedure.

steps.title: Inject MCU−/− cells
steps.instruction: Inject MCU−/− cells into the SCID mice and monitor for tumor growth.
steps.expected_result: MCU−/− cells are successfully injected and monitored for tumor development.

steps.title: Measure NADH levels
steps.instruction: Evaluate cellular NADH levels in MCU-silenced TNBC cell lines.
steps.expected_result: Data on NADH levels in response to MCU downregulation is collected.

steps.title: Assess ATP production
steps.instruction: Measure ATP production in MCU-silenced TNBC cell lines.
steps.expected_result: Data on ATP production is obtained for analysis.

steps.title: Prepare ROS measurement
steps.instruction: Set up the experiment to measure mitochondrial hydrogen peroxide levels.
steps.expected_result: Experimental setup for ROS measurement is complete.

steps.title: Measure mitochondrial ROS
steps.instruction: Measure mitochondrial hydrogen peroxide levels in TNBC cell lines.
steps.expected_result: Data on mitochondrial ROS production is collected.

steps.title: Select TNBC cell lines
steps.instruction: Choose BT-549, MDA-MB-468, and MDA-MB-231 cell lines for expression analysis.
steps.expected_result: Selected TNBC cell lines are ready for analysis.

steps.title: Analyze expression levels
steps.instruction: Examine the expression levels of MCU and related proteins in the selected TNBC cell lines.
steps.expected_result: Expression levels of MCU and related proteins are analyzed.

steps.title: Design siRNA for MCU
steps.instruction: Design specific siRNA to inhibit MCU expression in TNBC cell lines.
steps.expected_result: siRNA targeting MCU is designed and ready for use.

steps.title: Transfect TNBC cell lines
steps.instruction: Transfect TNBC cell lines with the designed siRNA to silence MCU expression.
steps.expected_result: MCU expression is successfully silenced in TNBC cell lines.

steps.title: Set up wound healing assay

steps.expected_result: Wound healing assay setup is complete and ready for monitoring.

steps.title: Monitor cell migration
steps.instruction: Monitor and record cell motility in the wound healing assay over time.
steps.expected_result: Data on cell migration in response to MCU silencing is collected.

steps.instruction: Prepare agonists for stimulating cytosolic Ca2+ transients in MCU-silenced TNBC cell lines.

steps.title: Measure Ca2+ transients
steps.instruction: Evaluate cytosolic Ca2+ transients in response to agonist stimulation in MCU-silenced TNBC cell lines.
steps.expected_result: Data on cytosolic Ca2+ transients is collected.

steps.instruction: Separate the required number of starved planarians and wash them with fresh Montjuïc salts.
steps.expected_result: Planarians are clean and ready for further processing.

steps.title: Add CMFB to planarians
steps.instruction: Transfer the washed planarians to a culture dish and add an appropriate volume of CMFB to cover them.
steps.expected_result: Planarians are submerged in CMFB.

steps.title: Dicing planarians
steps.instruction: Using a scalpel, slice the planarians into small fragments, ensuring no large pieces remain.
steps.expected_result: Planarians are diced into small tissue fragments.

steps.title: Dissociate cells
steps.instruction: Add CMFB to the diced fragments and mechanically dissociate the cells using a wide-bore pipette.
steps.expected_result: Cell suspension is created with minimal undissociated fragments.

steps.title: Strain cell suspension
steps.instruction: Collect the cell suspension and strain it through a 40um strainer into a fresh centrifuge tube.
steps.expected_result: Strained cell suspension is ready for centrifugation.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the strained cell suspension and resuspend the pellet in 1P M+10% FBS media.
steps.expected_result: Cell pellet is resuspended and ready for staining.

steps.title: Stain with Hoechst and MTG
steps.instruction: Add Hoechst 33342 to the cell suspension and incubate, mixing intermittently, followed by adding MTG and incubating again.
steps.expected_result: Cells are stained with Hoechst and MTG.

steps.title: Treat cells with Verapamil
steps.instruction: Add Verapamil to the stained cell suspension to inhibit efflux pumps.
steps.expected_result: Cells are treated with Verapamil.

steps.title: Generate PIWI-1 antibody
steps.instruction: Create and validate an antibody specific to PIWI-1 for immunostaining.
steps.expected_result: PIWI-1 antibody is generated and validated.

steps.title: Immunostain with PIWI-1
steps.instruction: Perform immunostaining on the planarian cells using the generated PIWI-1 antibody.
steps.expected_result: Cells are stained for PIWI-1 expression.

steps.title: Prepare X1 populations for RNA-seq
steps.instruction: Sort X1-MTG Low and X1-MTG High populations from the stained cell suspension.
steps.expected_result: X1 populations are isolated for RNA sequencing.

steps.title: Analyze transcriptome data
steps.instruction: Use Cuffdiff analysis to identify differentially expressed genes between X1-MTG Low and High cells.
steps.expected_result: Differentially expressed genes are identified.

steps.title: Sort X2 populations
steps.instruction: Separate X2-MTG Low and High cells based on their MTG signal and size.
steps.expected_result: X2 populations are sorted for further analysis.

steps.title: Conduct RNA-seq on X2 populations
steps.instruction: Perform RNA sequencing on sorted X2-MTG Low and High populations.
steps.expected_result: Transcriptomic profiles of X2 populations are obtained.

steps.title: Analyze cell cycle status
steps.instruction: Perform cell cycle analysis on sorted X2-MTG Low cells to confirm their phase.
steps.expected_result: Cell cycle status of X2-MTG Low cells is determined.

steps.title: Transplant MTG populations
steps.instruction: Inject sorted MTG populations into lethally irradiated planarians.
steps.expected_result: MTG populations are transplanted into irradiated animals.

steps.title: Prepare and stain planarian cells

steps.title: Analyze differentially expressed genes
steps.instruction: Use Cuffdiff analysis to identify differentially regulated genes between X1-MTG Low and High cells.
steps.expected_result: Differentially expressed genes are identified.

steps.title: Sacrifice Mice
steps.instruction: Sacrifice a mouse at the desired day of gestation (E15.5 or E16.5) following all relevant regulations.
steps.expected_result: Mouse is sacrificed and ready for tissue dissection.

steps.title: Collect Embryos
steps.instruction: Carefully collect embryos using scissors and forceps, excising the epididymis with testis in HBSS buffer.
steps.expected_result: Embryos are collected and stored in HBSS buffer.

steps.title: Isolate Epididymis
steps.instruction: Remove the testis from the excised tissue to isolate the epididymis.
steps.expected_result: Epididymis is isolated from the testis.

steps.title: Incubate Isolated Epididymis
steps.instruction: Incubate the isolated epididymis in HBSS on ice.
steps.expected_result: Epididymis is incubated and ready for further processing.

steps.title: Prepare Fixative Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 4% PFA solution for fixing samples.
steps.expected_result: Fixative solution is ready for use.

steps.title: Prepare Primary Antibodies
steps.instruction: Dilute primary antibodies in PBST according to the required concentrations.
steps.expected_result: Primary antibodies are prepared for immunostaining.

steps.title: Fix Samples
steps.instruction: Add 2 ml of 4% PFA to the chamber containing the epididymis and incubate at 4°C overnight.
steps.expected_result: Samples are fixed and ready for staining.

steps.title: Transfer Samples to Microtube
steps.instruction: Remove epididymis from gels and transfer to a microtube containing PBST.
steps.expected_result: Epididymis is transferred to microtube for further processing.

steps.title: Block Samples
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl of 10% normal goat serum in PBST and incubate at 37°C for 3 hours.
steps.expected_result: Samples are blocked and ready for antibody staining.

steps.title: Mount Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer samples onto a glass base dish and remove surrounding liquids.
steps.expected_result: Samples are mounted and ready for imaging.

steps.title: Perform Imaging
steps.instruction: Acquire stack images of the samples using a confocal microscope.
steps.expected_result: Images of the samples are captured for analysis.

steps.title: Surgically Excise Epididymides
steps.instruction: Carefully excise the epididymides from the embryos.
steps.expected_result: Epididymides are surgically excised and ready for culture.

steps.title: Culture Epididymides
steps.instruction: Place the excised epididymides in a culture medium.
steps.expected_result: Epididymides are cultured in the medium.

steps.title: Hydrophilize PDMS Chamber
steps.instruction: Hydrophilize the PDMS stretch chamber using plasma cleaning equipment.
steps.expected_result: PDMS chamber is prepared for tissue compression.

steps.title: Stretch PDMS Chamber
steps.instruction: Insert the PDMS chamber into the uniaxial stretching device and stretch it according to manufacturer recommendations.
steps.expected_result: PDMS chamber is stretched and ready for sample insertion.

steps.title: Transfer Epididymides to Chamber
steps.instruction: Transfer the isolated epididymides into the chamber and remove excess HBSS buffer.

steps.title: Fill Chamber with Gel
steps.instruction: Fill the chamber with 1 ml of collagen gel or Matrigel without dilution.

steps.title: Incubate for Gelation

steps.expected_result: Gel is set and ready for tissue compression.

steps.title: Prepare for Protein Extraction
steps.instruction: Isolate the epididymides for total protein extraction.
steps.expected_result: Epididymides are prepared for protein extraction.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Western Blotting
steps.instruction: Prepare the samples for SDS-PAGE by adding appropriate buffers.
steps.expected_result: Samples are ready for SDS-PAGE.

steps.title: Measure Angles in Mitotic Cells
steps.instruction: Analyze the angles of mitotic cells to assess division orientation.
steps.expected_result: Data on cell division orientation is collected.

steps.title: Perform Co-immunostaining
steps.instruction: Conduct co-immunostaining for apical junction morphology analysis.
steps.expected_result: Samples are stained for analysis of apical junctions.

steps.title: Transfer Proteins to Membranes
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins from SDS-PAGE to membranes for western blotting.
steps.expected_result: Proteins are successfully transferred and ready for antibody incubation.

steps.expected_result: The sequences are submitted for analysis.

steps.instruction: Run the analysis to identify the acetyl-CoA-binding site within the sequences.
steps.expected_result: The results display the presence of the acetyl-CoA-binding site.

steps.title: Collect related protein sequences
steps.instruction: Gather sequences of related proteins for alignment.
steps.expected_result: A list of related protein sequences is compiled.

steps.title: Align sequences using Clustal W
steps.instruction: Input the related protein sequences into Clustal W for alignment.
steps.expected_result: The sequences are aligned and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Align sequences using MUSCLE
steps.instruction: Input the same related protein sequences into MUSCLE for a second alignment.
steps.expected_result: The sequences are aligned using MUSCLE and ready for comparison.

steps.title: Export alignment results
steps.instruction: Export the multiple sequence alignment results in Newick format.
steps.expected_result: The alignment is saved in Newick format for further analysis.

steps.title: Prepare cloning vectors
steps.instruction: Select and prepare the specified vectors for cloning constructs.
steps.expected_result: Cloning vectors are ready for the insertion of constructs.

steps.title: Amplify TF or CoREG ORFs
steps.instruction: Use high-fidelity polymerase to amplify the targeted TF or CoREG ORFs.
steps.expected_result: Amplified ORFs are generated and ready for cloning.

steps.title: Screen colonies for inserts
steps.instruction: Perform colony PCR or restriction digestion on kanamycin-resistant colonies.
steps.expected_result: Results indicate which colonies contain inserts of the correct size and orientation.

steps.title: Prepare samples for sequencing
steps.instruction: Prepare the selected clones for Sanger dideoxy sequencing.
steps.expected_result: Samples are ready for sequencing confirmation.

steps.expected_result: Genomic DNA is isolated and ready for analysis.

steps.instruction: Treat total RNA samples with DNase to remove contaminating genomic DNA.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA

steps.expected_result: cDNA is synthesized and ready for RT-PCR amplification.

steps.title: Screen colonies for inserts
steps.instruction: Repeat screening of colonies for inserts of correct size and orientation using colony PCR or restriction digestion.

steps.title: Confirm insert sequences

steps.title: Chop maize leaves

steps.title: Digest leaves to isolate protoplasts

steps.title: Electroporate protoplasts
steps.instruction: Electroporate the isolated protoplasts with total DNA using specified voltage and pulse length.
steps.expected_result: Protoplasts are transformed and ready for transient assays.

steps.title: Thaw fungal mycelia
steps.instruction: Thaw a frozen stock of fungal mycelia at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: Mycelia are thawed and ready for plating.

steps.title: Plate mycelia
steps.instruction: Spread the thawed mycelia on NGM plates containing ampicillin and gentamycin.
steps.expected_result: Mycelia are evenly spread on the plates.

steps.title: Incubate plates
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates at 25°C for 1 week.
steps.expected_result: Mycelia grow and spores appear on the plates.

steps.title: Dislodge spores
steps.instruction: Using a bent sterile glass Pasteur pipette, gently rub the fungal colonies to dislodge the spores.
steps.expected_result: Spores are dislodged and ready for collection.

steps.title: Wash and collect spores
steps.instruction: Wash the dislodged spores from the plates using 1 ml of 50 mM NaCl and collect them into an Eppendorf tube.
steps.expected_result: Spores are collected in the Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Prepare for DNA extraction
steps.instruction: Incubate the collected spores or mycelia under appropriate conditions for DNA extraction.
steps.expected_result: Spores or mycelia are ready for DNA extraction.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Use the DNeasy Plant Mini Kit to extract DNA from the harvested mycelia.
steps.expected_result: Genomic DNA is extracted and purified.

steps.title: Collect spores for RNA extraction
steps.instruction: Collect spores and culture them in NGMY medium.
steps.expected_result: Spores are cultured and ready for RNA extraction.

steps.title: Prepare RNA samples
steps.instruction: Prepare samples from the cultured spores for RNA extraction.
steps.expected_result: RNA samples are ready for extraction.

steps.title: Homogenize samples
steps.instruction: Homogenize the collected spores or mycelia samples for RNA extraction.
steps.expected_result: Samples are homogenized and ready for RNA extraction.

steps.title: Prepare DNA libraries
steps.instruction: Prepare paired-end libraries from the extracted genomic DNA for sequencing.
steps.expected_result: DNA libraries are prepared and ready for sequencing.

steps.title: Construct sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Prepare paired-end libraries from the extracted genomic DNA and mRNA for sequencing.
steps.expected_result: Sequencing libraries are constructed and ready for sequencing.

steps.title: Process sequencing reads
steps.instruction: Process the sequencing reads using appropriate software tools for de novo genome assembly.
steps.expected_result: Reads are processed and ready for assembly.

steps.title: Create whole genome map
steps.instruction: Generate a whole genome map using size-optimized restriction fragments.
steps.expected_result: Whole genome map is created.

steps.title: Annotate genome
steps.instruction: Perform genome annotation and identify repetitive elements and protein domains.
steps.expected_result: Genome is annotated with identified elements and domains.

steps.title: Align sequences
steps.instruction: Align sequences and calculate phylogenetic distances among fungal species.
steps.expected_result: Phylogenetic analysis results are obtained.

steps.title: Predict secreted proteins
steps.instruction: Analyze the secretome to predict secreted proteins and their localization in host organisms.
steps.expected_result: Secreted proteins and their localization are predicted.

steps.title: Dispense siRNA SMARTpools
steps.instruction: Dispense siRNA SMARTpools into triplicate black 384-well plates.
steps.expected_result: Each well of the plates contains the appropriate siRNA SMARTpool.

steps.title: Seal the plates
steps.instruction: Seal the plates to prevent contamination.
steps.expected_result: Plates are securely sealed and ready for the next step.

steps.title: Prepare transfection reagent
steps.instruction: Dilute transfection reagent in HBSS according to protocol.
steps.expected_result: Transfection reagent is prepared and ready for use.

steps.title: Add transfection reagent to plates
steps.instruction: Add the diluted transfection reagent to each well of the plates.
steps.expected_result: Transfection complexes are formed in each well.

steps.title: Wash Hela cells
steps.instruction: Remove media from Hela cells and rinse gently with sterile PBS.
steps.expected_result: Hela cells are washed and ready for trypsinization.

steps.title: Trypsinize Hela cells
steps.instruction: Add trypsin to the Hela cells and incubate until cells are dislodged.
steps.expected_result: Hela cells are fully dislodged and in suspension.

steps.title: Dilute and add Hela cells
steps.instruction: Dilute the trypsinized Hela cells to the appropriate density and add to the plates.
steps.expected_result: Hela cells are seeded into the plates at the correct density.

steps.title: Remove media from plates
steps.instruction: Remove media from the wells of the plates by inverting and shaking over disinfectant.
steps.expected_result: Wells are free of media and ready for virus addition.

steps.title: Add virus inoculum
steps.instruction: Add virus or media containing penicillin-streptomycin to the wells.
steps.expected_result: Virus inoculum is added to the appropriate wells.

steps.title: Monitor eGFP fluorescence
steps.instruction: Measure eGFP fluorescence at regular intervals to monitor virus replication.
steps.expected_result: Fluorescence data is collected for analysis over time.

steps.title: Add CTB reagent
steps.instruction: Add CTB reagent to the wells to assess cytotoxicity of siRNAs.
steps.expected_result: CTB reagent is added and ready for analysis of live cell count.

steps.title: Deconvolute SMARTpools
steps.instruction: Deconvolute the siRNA SMARTpools for selected candidates.
steps.expected_result: SMARTpools are deconvoluted and ready for validation.

steps.title: Assess siRNA effects
steps.instruction: Evaluate the effects of siRNAs on virus replication across different viral strains.
steps.expected_result: Data on siRNA effects on virus replication is collected.

steps.title: Prepare viral vectors
steps.instruction: Obtain AAV, adenoviral, and lentiviral vectors for testing.
steps.expected_result: Viral vectors are ready for infectivity testing.

steps.title: Infect embryos with viral vectors
steps.instruction: Introduce the prepared viral vectors into the embryos.
steps.expected_result: Embryos are infected with the viral vectors.

steps.title: Assess infectivity
steps.instruction: Evaluate the infectivity of the viral vectors in the embryos.
steps.expected_result: Data on the infectivity of each viral vector is collected.

steps.title: Prepare viral vector solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the viral vector encoding EGFP in an appropriate medium.
steps.expected_result: Viral vector solution is ready for microinjection.

steps.title: Microinject viral vector
steps.instruction: Microinject the prepared viral vector into the perivitelline space of pronuclear-stage embryos.
steps.expected_result: Viral vector is successfully injected into the embryos.

steps.title: Prepare Cas9-RNP solution
steps.instruction: Reconstitute crRNA and tracrRNA, and prepare Cas9-RNP solution.
steps.expected_result: Cas9-RNP solution is ready for electroporation.

steps.title: Electroporate embryos
steps.instruction: Introduce Cas9-RNP into pronuclear-stage embryos using electroporation.
steps.expected_result: Cas9-RNP is successfully introduced into the embryos.

steps.title: Prepare scAAV vector solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the scAAV vector harboring donor DNA in an appropriate medium.
steps.expected_result: scAAV vector solution is ready for injection.

steps.title: Inject scAAV vector
steps.instruction: Inject the prepared scAAV vector into the embryos after electroporation.
steps.expected_result: scAAV vector is successfully injected into the embryos.

steps.title: Collect embryos for analysis
steps.instruction: Collect embryos at the appropriate developmental stage for knockin efficiency assessment.
steps.expected_result: Embryos are collected and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Assess knockin efficiency
steps.instruction: Evaluate the efficiency of knockin at the Rosa26 locus in the collected embryos.
steps.expected_result: Data on knockin efficiency is obtained.

steps.title: Collect N1 generation offspring
steps.instruction: Collect N1 generation offspring for genotyping.
steps.expected_result: N1 generation offspring are ready for genotyping.

steps.title: Perform genotyping
steps.instruction: Genotype the collected N1 generation offspring to confirm germline transmission.
steps.expected_result: Genotyping results confirm or deny germline transmission.

steps.title: Prepare scAAV vector for exon exchange
steps.instruction: Obtain and prepare the scAAV vector for exchanging the mutated exon.
steps.expected_result: scAAV vector for exon exchange is ready.

steps.title: Inject scAAV vector into embryos
steps.instruction: Inject the prepared scAAV vector into embryos to rescue the nude phenotype.
steps.expected_result: scAAV vector is successfully injected into the embryos.

steps.title: Collect blood samples
steps.instruction: Collect peripheral blood samples from mice with exchanged exon.
steps.expected_result: Blood samples are collected for analysis.

steps.title: Analyze T cell recovery
steps.instruction: Evaluate the presence of CD3+ T lymphocytes in the collected blood samples.
steps.expected_result: Data on T cell recovery is obtained.

steps.title: Prepare embryos for microscopy
steps.instruction: Collect morula/blastocyst stage embryos for fluorescence microscopy.
steps.expected_result: Embryos are prepared for imaging.

steps.title: Confirm EGFP expression
steps.instruction: Use fluorescence microscopy to confirm the expression of EGFP in the embryos.
steps.expected_result: EGFP expression is confirmed in the embryos.

steps.instruction: Reconstitute crRNA and tracrRNA, and prepare Cas9-RNP solution for electroporation.
steps.expected_result: Cas9-RNP solution is ready for electroporation.

steps.title: Electroporate embryos
steps.instruction: Introduce Cas9-RNP into pronuclear-stage embryos using electroporation.
steps.expected_result: Cas9-RNP is successfully introduced into the embryos.

steps.title: Prepare scAAV vector solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the self-complementary AAV vector harboring CAG-GFP cassette in an appropriate medium.
steps.expected_result: scAAV vector solution is ready for infection.

steps.title: Infect embryos with scAAV vector
steps.instruction: Introduce the prepared scAAV vector into the embryos.
steps.expected_result: Embryos are infected with the scAAV vector.

steps.title: Collect embryos for analysis
steps.instruction: Collect blastocyst stage embryos for knockin efficiency assessment.
steps.expected_result: Blastocyst stage embryos are ready for analysis.

steps.instruction: Grow 293T, 293L, and iSLK.219 cells in appropriate media with necessary supplements.

steps.title: Cell Maintenance
steps.instruction: Monitor cell growth and maintain cultures by passaging as needed.
steps.expected_result: Cultures remain at optimal density for experiments.

steps.title: PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification of target sequences to generate plasmids.
steps.expected_result: Amplified DNA fragments suitable for cloning.

steps.title: Cloning
steps.instruction: Clone PCR products into appropriate vectors.
steps.expected_result: Recombinant plasmids are generated for further analysis.

steps.title: Homologous Recombination Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare the KSHV BAC16 and the epitope tag for insertion.
steps.expected_result: Components are ready for homologous recombination.

steps.title: Recombination Process
steps.instruction: Insert the epitope tag into KSHV BAC16 using homologous recombination.
steps.expected_result: KSHV BAC16 with the epitope tag is generated.

steps.title: Transfection Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare expression vectors for transfection into 293T cells.
steps.expected_result: Expression vectors are ready for transfection.

steps.title: Transfection
steps.instruction: Transfect 293T cells with prepared expression vectors.
steps.expected_result: Cells are successfully transfected and ready for incubation.

steps.title: Cell Harvesting
steps.instruction: Harvest approximately 20 million cells and prepare for cross-linking.
steps.expected_result: Cell pellet is ready for cross-linking.

steps.title: Cross-Linking
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in formaldehyde solution and incubate to cross-link chromatin.
steps.expected_result: Chromatin is cross-linked and ready for immunoprecipitation.

steps.title: Chromatin Shearing
steps.instruction: Sonicate cross-linked chromatin to shear DNA into appropriate fragment sizes.
steps.expected_result: Sheared chromatin is prepared for immunoprecipitation.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: Add specific antibodies to sheared chromatin and perform immunoprecipitation.
steps.expected_result: Chromatin-protein complexes are captured.

steps.title: Library Preparation Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare ChIP-extracted DNA for library preparation using NEXTflexTM ChIP-Seq Kit.
steps.expected_result: DNA is ready for library preparation steps.

steps.title: End Repair and Size Selection
steps.instruction: Perform end repair and size selection of DNA fragments.
steps.expected_result: Purified DNA fragments between 300-400 bp are obtained.

steps.title: Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate adapters to the purified DNA fragments.
steps.expected_result: Adapter-ligated DNA is prepared for amplification.

steps.title: Data Analysis Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare sequencing data for analysis to identify enriched peaks.
steps.expected_result: Data is organized and ready for peak identification.

steps.title: Peak Identification
steps.instruction: Analyze sequencing data to identify enriched regions in ChIP samples.
steps.expected_result: Enriched peaks are identified and documented.

steps.title: Dissect Drosophila larval brains
steps.instruction: Dissect the required number of larval brains in PBS.
steps.expected_result: Larval brains are collected in PBS for further processing.

steps.title: Fix larval brains
steps.instruction: Fix the dissected larval brains with 1% formaldehyde for 10 minutes at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: Larval brains are fixed and ready for quenching.

steps.title: Quench crosslinking of larval brains
steps.instruction: Quench the crosslinking by adding 125 mM glycine and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: Crosslinking of larval brains is quenched.

steps.title: Wash and dissociate larval brains
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed brains with PBS and add dissociation solution, incubating for 1 hour at 30°C with shaking.

steps.title: Monitor parasite growth

steps.instruction: Euthanize the infected mouse according to institutional guidelines and perform cardiac puncture to collect blood.

steps.instruction: Dilute the harvested blood into pre-warmed sterile Alsever’s solution to prepare the inoculum.
steps.expected_result: Inoculum prepared and ready for injection into a new mouse.

steps.instruction: Administer the prepared inoculum to the new mouse via intraperitoneal injection.
steps.expected_result: New mouse successfully infected with P. berghei parasites.

steps.title: Daily monitoring of infected mice
steps.instruction: Observe and record the health status and survival of infected mice daily, especially for neurological symptoms.
steps.expected_result: Comprehensive health records of infected mice maintained.

steps.instruction: Document the number of surviving mice and any observed signs of cerebral malaria.
steps.expected_result: Accurate records of mortality and health parameters for analysis.

steps.instruction: Collect blood samples from infected mice and prepare thin-film blood smears for Giemsa staining.
steps.expected_result: Blood smears prepared and ready for staining.

steps.instruction: Submerge the prepared blood smears in Giemsa staining solution for the appropriate duration.
steps.expected_result: Stained blood smears ready for microscopic analysis.

steps.title: Analyze stained smears
steps.instruction: Count the number of infected and uninfected erythrocytes in the stained smears using a microscope.
steps.expected_result: Data on parasitemia calculated and recorded.

steps.title: Collect blood for cytokine analysis
steps.instruction: Euthanize the mouse according to institutional guidelines and collect blood for plasma isolation.
steps.expected_result: Blood collected and ready for cytokine analysis.

steps.title: Measure cytokine levels
steps.instruction: Use a multiplexed assay to measure cytokine levels in the isolated plasma samples.
steps.expected_result: Cytokine levels quantified and data prepared for analysis.

steps.title: Prepare Dissection Materials
steps.instruction: Prepare glass Pasteur pipettes by inscribing circles and creating openings of 1mm or 5mm diameter.
steps.expected_result: Glass Pasteur pipettes are ready for use in dissection.

steps.title: Heat-Polish Pipette Ends
steps.instruction: Heat-polish the cut ends of the Pasteur pipettes to prevent injuries to myofibers.
steps.expected_result: Pipettes are polished and safe for handling myofibers.

steps.title: Prepare Disaggregation Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 mL of 0.2% type I collagenase solution in DMEM containing 1% PS and sterilize it.
steps.expected_result: Sterilized collagenase solution is ready for use.

steps.title: Incubate Collagenase Solution
steps.instruction: Place the sterilized collagenase solution in a CO2 incubator at 37°C.
steps.expected_result: Collagenase solution is prewarmed and ready for dissection.

steps.title: Isolate EDL Muscle
steps.instruction: Sacrifice the mouse and isolate the EDL muscle by removing surrounding tissues and tendons.
steps.expected_result: Isolated EDL muscle is ready for digestion.

steps.title: Digest EDL Muscle
steps.instruction: Place the isolated EDL muscle into the collagenase solution and incubate under appropriate conditions.
steps.expected_result: Muscle is digested into individual myofibers.

steps.title: Collect Individual Myofibers
steps.instruction: Use small pipettes to collect individual myofibers from the digestion medium.
steps.expected_result: Individual myofibers are isolated and ready for further experiments.

steps.title: Prepare Muscle Extracts
steps.instruction: Apply tibialis anterior muscle extracts to the isolated myofibers.
steps.expected_result: Myofibers are treated with muscle extracts.

steps.title: Incubate Myofibers
steps.instruction: Incubate the treated myofibers for 24 hours under appropriate conditions.
steps.expected_result: Myofibers are incubated and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Co-culture Myofibers
steps.instruction: Transfer intact myofibers and mechanically damaged myofibers into a co-culture setup.
steps.expected_result: Intact and damaged myofibers are co-cultured.

steps.title: Confirm Myofiber Ratio
steps.instruction: Ensure the ratio of intact to damaged myofibers is 1:1 using a stereo microscope.
steps.expected_result: Correct ratio of myofibers is confirmed.

steps.title: Prepare for Immunofluorescence
steps.instruction: Coat tubes and pipettes with 5% BSA to prevent myofiber adhesion.
steps.expected_result: Materials are prepared for immunofluorescence analysis.

steps.title: Fix Myofibers
steps.instruction: Add 2% PFA in PBS to the myofibers for fixation.
steps.expected_result: Myofibers are fixed and ready for washing.

steps.title: Incubate with Antibodies
steps.instruction: Incubate myofibers with primary antibodies overnight at 4°C.
steps.expected_result: Myofibers are incubated with antibodies for analysis.

steps.title: Wash Out Damaged Myofibers
steps.instruction: Aspirate the culture medium and wash out damaged myofibers with fresh DMEM.
steps.expected_result: Damaged myofibers are removed and replaced with fresh medium.

steps.title: Conduct Proteome Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform proteome analysis on the isolated myofibers to identify DMDFs.
steps.expected_result: Proteome data is obtained for DMDF identification.

steps.title: Treat Myofibers with Recombinant DMDFs
steps.instruction: Apply recombinant DMDF proteins to the isolated myofibers.
steps.expected_result: Myofibers are treated with DMDFs for analysis.

steps.title: Test Chemical Inhibitors
steps.instruction: Apply various concentrations of chemical inhibitors to the satellite cells.
steps.expected_result: Effects of inhibitors on satellite cell activation are assessed.

steps.title: Isolate Myofibers from Muscle Tissue
steps.instruction: Repeat the isolation of myofibers from TA and EDL muscles for experimentation.
steps.expected_result: Additional myofibers are isolated and ready for use.

steps.title: Apply Muscle Extracts to Myofibers
steps.instruction: Treat isolated myofibers with tibialis anterior muscle extracts for 24 hours.
steps.expected_result: Myofibers are treated and ready for subsequent analysis.

steps.title: Conduct Immunofluorescence Studies
steps.instruction: Perform immunofluorescence analysis to evaluate satellite cell markers.
steps.expected_result: Expression of satellite cell markers is quantified.

steps.title: Mechanically Damage Myofibers
steps.instruction: Use a Pasteur pipette to apply mechanical damage to intact myofibers.
steps.expected_result: Myofibers exhibit hypercontracted morphology confirming damage.

steps.title: Compile experimental data

steps.expected_result: Experimental data is compiled and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Perform statistical analyses
steps.instruction: Conduct statistical analyses on the compiled data to interpret results.
steps.expected_result: Statistical analysis results are obtained for interpretation.

steps.title: Gather TDP43 homolog sequences
steps.instruction: Collect protein sequences of 93 vertebrate TDP43 homologs from relevant databases.
steps.expected_result: A comprehensive list of TDP43 homolog sequences is compiled.

steps.title: Categorize homologs
steps.instruction: Classify the collected TDP43 homolog sequences into NTDs, RRM domains, and CTDs.
steps.expected_result: A categorized database of TDP43 homologs is created.

steps.title: Select sequences for analysis
steps.instruction: Choose the relevant TDP43 homolog sequences for calculating sequence diversity.
steps.expected_result: A subset of sequences is identified for diversity analysis.

steps.title: Calculate edit distance
steps.instruction: Compute the Levenshtein or edit distance for each selected TDP43 homolog sequence, normalizing to a length of 100 amino acids.
steps.expected_result: A matrix of sequence diversity values is generated.

steps.title: Identify conserved and disordered regions
steps.instruction: Analyze the TDP43 sequences to identify conserved regions and intrinsically disordered regions.
steps.expected_result: Regions of interest are marked for further analysis.

steps.title: Analyze amino-acid composition
steps.instruction: Calculate the amino-acid composition of the identified conserved and disordered regions.
steps.expected_result: A report detailing the amino-acid composition is produced.

steps.title: Design TDP43RRM-GFP construct
steps.instruction: Create a construct that replaces the RNA-binding RRM domains of TDP43 with GFP.
steps.expected_result: A plasmid containing the TDP43RRM-GFP reporter is generated.

steps.title: Prepare CTD mutant panel
steps.instruction: Generate a panel of CTD mutants with systematic alterations in hydrophobic motifs.
steps.expected_result: A collection of CTD mutants is ready for screening.

steps.title: Set up microscopy and flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Prepare the high-throughput automated confocal microscopy and flow cytometry systems for monitoring GFP fluorescence.
steps.expected_result: Microscopy and flow cytometry systems are operational.

steps.title: Harvest TDP43 variants
steps.instruction: Isolate full-length TDP43 variants with wild-type and mutant CTDs from bacterial cultures.
steps.expected_result: Purified TDP43 variants are obtained.

steps.title: Prepare RNA samples
steps.instruction: Obtain RNA samples at varying concentrations for testing effects on phase separation.
steps.expected_result: A set of RNA samples is prepared for experimentation.

steps.title: Set up live-cell reporter assay
steps.instruction: Establish the live-cell reporter assay to investigate interactions in TDP43 condensates.
steps.expected_result: The live-cell reporter assay is ready for use.

steps.instruction: Identify the human TDP43 CTD sequence for hydrophobicity analysis.
steps.expected_result: The TDP43 CTD sequence is ready for analysis.

steps.title: Calculate hydrophobicity
steps.instruction: Apply a sliding window approach with various hydrophobicity scales to determine the hydrophobicity of the TDP43 CTD.
steps.expected_result: A hydrophobicity profile of the TDP43 CTD is generated.

steps.title: Design mutation strategy
steps.instruction: Plan the specific mutations to introduce in the TDP43 IDRs, changing hydrophobic residues to serine.
steps.expected_result: A detailed mutation strategy is outlined.

steps.title: Introduce mutations
steps.instruction: Perform the mutagenesis to introduce the planned mutations in the TDP43 IDRs.
steps.expected_result: Mutated TDP43 IDRs are generated.

steps.title: Prepare cDNA inserts
steps.instruction: Synthesize specific nano/monobody binding domains with appropriate restriction sites.
steps.expected_result: cDNA inserts ready for cloning.

steps.title: Digest GeneArt vector
steps.instruction: Digest the re-suspended GeneArt vector with EcoRI and NotI.
steps.expected_result: Digested vector ready for ligation.

steps.title: Run agarose gel
steps.instruction: Run the digest on a 1% agarose gel and excise the released cDNA insert.
steps.expected_result: Isolated cDNA insert from gel.

steps.title: Ligate inserts into vectors
steps.instruction: Ligate the AdPROM insert into the accepting vectors using the Rapid DNA Ligation Kit.
steps.expected_result: Ligation reaction completed.

steps.title: Transform competent cells
steps.instruction: Add ligation reaction to competent DH5α cells and perform heat shock.
steps.expected_result: Transformed cells ready for plating.

steps.title: Select colonies
steps.instruction: Plate transformed cells onto LB agar plates with ampicillin and incubate overnight.
steps.expected_result: Colonies of transformed cells appear on the plate.

steps.title: Verify plasmids
steps.instruction: Pick colonies and propagate in LB medium, then perform miniprep and diagnostic digest.
steps.expected_result: Confirmed plasmids ready for sequencing.

steps.title: Culture HEK-293 FT cells
steps.instruction: Seed HEK-293 FT cells in complete medium and incubate overnight.
steps.expected_result: Cells reach 70% confluency.

steps.title: Prepare transfection mix
steps.instruction: Combine plasmids and PEI in serum-free Opti-MEM for transfection.
steps.expected_result: Transfection mix ready for application.

steps.title: Transfect HEK-293 FT cells
steps.instruction: Add the transfection mix drop-wise to the cultured HEK-293 FT cells.
steps.expected_result: Cells exposed to transfection mix.

steps.title: Collect retrovirus-containing medium
steps.instruction: After incubation, collect the medium from transfected HEK-293 FT cells.
steps.expected_result: Medium containing retroviruses collected.

steps.title: Filter retrovirus medium
steps.instruction: Filter the collected medium through sterile syringe filters.
steps.expected_result: Filtered retrovirus medium ready for infection.

steps.title: Infect target cells
steps.instruction: Add filtered retrovirus medium to target cells for infection.
steps.expected_result: Target cells exposed to retroviruses.

steps.title: Select infected cells
steps.instruction: Treat infected target cells with puromycin to select for integrated retroviruses.
steps.expected_result: Surviving cells are those that have integrated the retrovirus.

steps.title: Wash and lyse cells
steps.instruction: Wash cells with PBS and lyse in ice-cold lysis buffer.
steps.expected_result: Cell lysates prepared for protein extraction.

steps.title: Incubate with anti-FLAG resin
steps.instruction: Incubate cell lysates with anti-FLAG M2 resin to isolate FLAG-tagged proteins.
steps.expected_result: FLAG-tagged proteins bound to resin.

steps.title: Perform SDS-PAGE
steps.instruction: Load samples onto SDS-PAGE gel and run to separate proteins.
steps.expected_result: Proteins separated by size.

steps.title: Isolate RNA from cells
steps.instruction: Isolate RNA from cultured cells for RT-PCR analysis.
steps.expected_result: RNA extracted and ready for cDNA synthesis.

steps.title: Transfect with siRNA
steps.instruction: Transfect target cells with siRNA to knock down gene expression.
steps.expected_result: Cells treated with siRNA for gene knockdown.

steps.title: Prepare antibodies
steps.instruction: Dilute primary antibodies and prepare secondary antibodies for western blotting.
steps.expected_result: Antibodies ready for use in western blot.

steps.title: Culture cancer cell lines
steps.instruction: Culture various cancer cell lines under specified conditions.
steps.expected_result: Cancer cell lines ready for treatment.

steps.title: Transfect 293-FT cells
steps.instruction: Co-transfect 293-FT cells with retroviral plasmids to produce retroviruses.
steps.expected_result: 293-FT cells transfected and producing retroviruses.
