steps.title: Collect Drosophila heads
steps.instruction: Select and anesthetize Drosophila flies, then collect their heads in a tube on ice.
steps.expected_result: Heads of Drosophila are collected and kept on ice for further processing.

steps.title: Homogenize collected heads
steps.instruction: Add Protein-mRNA lysis buffer to the collected heads and manually homogenize using a pestle.
steps.expected_result: A homogenate of Drosophila heads in lysis buffer is prepared.

steps.title: Centrifuge homogenate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate to separate debris from the lysate.
steps.expected_result: Supernatant containing mRNA is collected, while debris is discarded.

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Add Trizol reagent to the collected lysate, mix, and follow the extraction protocol to isolate RNA.
steps.expected_result: Isolated RNA is obtained and stored for analysis.

steps.title: Prepare GeneChip Arrays
steps.instruction: Obtain GeneChip arrays and prepare them according to the manufacturer's instructions.
steps.expected_result: GeneChip arrays are ready for hybridization.

steps.title: Hybridize mRNAs to GeneChip Arrays
steps.instruction: Apply isolated mRNAs to the prepared GeneChip arrays for hybridization.
steps.expected_result: mRNAs are hybridized to the GeneChip arrays.

steps.title: Prepare cDNA from mRNA
steps.instruction: Retrotranscribe isolated mRNA into cDNA using Superscript Vilo Master Mix.
steps.expected_result: cDNA is synthesized and ready for quantitative RT-PCR.

steps.title: Perform quantitative RT-PCR
steps.instruction: Use diluted cDNA with specific primers to perform quantitative RT-PCR.
steps.expected_result: Quantitative RT-PCR results are obtained for analysis.

steps.title: Prepare inhibitors
steps.instruction: Obtain nucleoside and non-nucleoside inhibitors for treatment.
steps.expected_result: Inhibitors are ready for administration to flies.

steps.title: Administer inhibitors to flies
steps.instruction: Treat TBPH-null flies with the prepared inhibitors to assess their effects.
steps.expected_result: TBPH-null flies are treated with inhibitors.

steps.title: Design RNAi constructs
steps.instruction: Create RNAi constructs targeting gypsy expression for transgenic flies.
steps.expected_result: RNAi constructs are designed and ready for use.

steps.title: Introduce RNAi constructs into flies
steps.instruction: Introduce the RNAi constructs into TBPH-null flies to silence gypsy expression.
steps.expected_result: Transgenic flies with silenced gypsy expression are generated.

steps.title: Extract RNA from heads
steps.instruction: Isolate RNA from TBPH-mutant heads using the previously described RNA extraction protocol.
steps.expected_result: RNA from TBPH-mutant heads is isolated for analysis.

steps.title: Perform qRT-PCR for Dicer-2
steps.instruction: Use qRT-PCR to test expression levels of Dicer-2 in the isolated RNA.
steps.expected_result: Expression levels of Dicer-2 are quantified.

steps.title: Prepare FLAG-tagged TBPH
steps.instruction: Express FLAG-tagged TBPH in neurons for pull-down assays.
steps.expected_result: FLAG-tagged TBPH is expressed and ready for interaction studies.

steps.title: Perform pull-down assays

steps.expected_result: Interaction data between TBPH and Dicer-2 is collected.

steps.title: Cross transgenic flies

steps.title: House rats
steps.instruction: House male albino Wistar rats in a controlled environment with appropriate temperature and humidity.
steps.expected_result: Rats are comfortably housed with free access to food and water.

steps.title: Monitor housing conditions
steps.instruction: Regularly check and maintain the temperature and humidity levels in the housing environment.
steps.expected_result: Stable housing conditions are ensured for the rats.

steps.title: Initiate chronic variate stress protocol
steps.instruction: Begin the 9-day variate stressor paradigm according to the schedule outlined in Table 1.
steps.expected_result: The stress protocol is initiated with the first stressor applied.

steps.title: Apply forced swimming stress
steps.instruction: Fill a glass tank with water at 23°C and place the rat in the tank for 10 minutes.
steps.expected_result: The rat undergoes forced swimming stress for the designated time.

steps.title: Apply restraint stress
steps.instruction: Place the rat in a plastic tube and secure it to prevent movement for 3 hours.
steps.expected_result: The rat is restrained and unable to move for the specified duration.

steps.title: Implement water deprivation
steps.instruction: Remove the water bottle from the cage for 24 hours.
steps.expected_result: The rat experiences water deprivation for the specified time.

steps.title: Conduct food deprivation
steps.instruction: Remove food from the cage for 24 hours.
steps.expected_result: The rat undergoes food deprivation for the specified duration.

steps.title: Return rats to normal conditions
steps.instruction: After each stressor application, return the rats to their cages with appropriate conditions.
steps.expected_result: Rats are returned to a normal environment after stress exposure.

steps.title: Anesthetize rats for blood collection
steps.instruction: Deeply anesthetize the rats prior to blood collection from the heart.
steps.expected_result: Rats are adequately anesthetized and ready for blood collection.

steps.title: Collect blood samples
steps.instruction: Collect blood from the heart of the anesthetized rats for serum corticosterone analysis.
steps.expected_result: Blood samples are obtained for subsequent analysis.

steps.title: Measure body weight
steps.instruction: Weigh the rats at the beginning and end of the 10-day treatment period.
steps.expected_result: Body weight data is collected for analysis.

steps.title: Acquire Arabidopsis accessions
steps.instruction: Contact the Nottingham Arabidopsis Stock Centre and other sources to request Arabidopsis accessions.
steps.expected_result: Arabidopsis accessions are obtained and ready for use.

steps.title: Receive and verify accessions
steps.instruction: Upon receiving the accessions, verify their identity and health status.
steps.expected_result: Verified Arabidopsis accessions are prepared for further experiments.

steps.title: Recombine ORF for HaRxL62
steps.instruction: Clone the ORF for HaRxL62 into a binary vector suitable for plant expression.

steps.title: Prepare NGM plates
steps.instruction: Prepare NGM plates according to the specified recipe.
steps.expected_result: NGM plates are ready for seeding with E. coli.

steps.title: Seed NGM plates with E. coli
steps.instruction: Seed prepared NGM plates with 200-300 μl of overnight grown E. coli OP50 under sterile conditions and allow to dry.
steps.expected_result: NGM plates are seeded and dried, ready for worm transfer.

steps.title: Transfer L4 stage worms
steps.instruction: Using a worm picker, transfer L4 stage CA1202 worms onto the seeded NGM plates.
steps.expected_result: Worms are placed on NGM plates to grow until adulthood.

steps.title: Recover gravid adults
steps.instruction: Wash the plates with ddH2O to recover gravid adults into a centrifuge tube.
steps.expected_result: Gravid adults are collected in the centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Perform sodium hypochlorite treatment
steps.instruction: Add ddH2O, KOH, and sodium hypochlorite to the tube and place on a tube rocker.
steps.expected_result: Worms are treated to release eggs.

steps.title: Centrifuge and wash eggs
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube to pellet released eggs, decant supernatant, and wash with ddH2O and M9 buffer.
steps.expected_result: Eggs are pelleted and washed, ready for incubation.

steps.title: Incubate eggs
steps.instruction: Add 1x M9 buffer to the egg pellet and incubate at 20°C on a low-speed tube rocker.
steps.expected_result: Eggs are incubated and ready for transfer to NGM plates.

steps.title: Prepare auxin-treated NGM plates
steps.instruction: Prepare NGM plates containing 1 mM or 4 mM K-NAA and seed with E. coli.
steps.expected_result: Auxin-treated NGM plates are ready for worm transfer.

steps.title: Recover synchronized worms
steps.instruction: Wash plates with 1x M9 buffer to recover synchronized worms into microcentrifuge tubes.
steps.expected_result: Synchronized worms are collected in tubes.

steps.title: Transfer worms to auxin plates
steps.instruction: Gently mix and dispense the worm suspension onto auxin-treated NGM plates.
steps.expected_result: Worms are evenly distributed on auxin plates.

steps.title: Observe auxin-induced degradation
steps.instruction: Wait for 30 minutes and observe the effects of auxin treatment under a spinning disk confocal microscope.
steps.expected_result: Auxin-induced degradation of AID-tagged proteins is observed.

steps.title: Prepare for imaging
steps.instruction: Set up the microscope and prepare the slide with worms for imaging.
steps.expected_result: Microscope is ready for imaging the worms.

steps.title: Acquire images
steps.instruction: Collect 16-bit z-stack images using the EM-CCD camera attached to the spinning disk confocal microscope.
steps.expected_result: Images of the worms are successfully acquired.

steps.title: Design gRNAs
steps.instruction: Identify PAM sequences and design guide RNAs targeting specific genes.
steps.expected_result: A set of designed gRNAs ready for cloning.

steps.title: Order oligonucleotides
steps.instruction: Order complementary single-stranded synthetic oligonucleotides for the designed gRNAs.
steps.expected_result: Received oligonucleotides for cloning.

steps.title: Clone gRNAs into pCRISPR-SacB
steps.instruction: Clone the designed gRNAs into the pCRISPR-SacB plasmid following the cloning protocol.
steps.expected_result: Construction of pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids.

steps.title: Prepare competent E. coli
steps.instruction: Prepare electrocompetent E. coli BL21(DE3)ΔompA cells for transformation.
steps.expected_result: Electrocompetent E. coli cells ready for transformation.

steps.title: Transform E. coli with plasmids
steps.instruction: Electroporate the prepared E. coli cells with the pCasRed and pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids.
steps.expected_result: Transformed E. coli cells containing the plasmids.

steps.title: Count colonies
steps.instruction: Count the colonies on LB-agar plates to determine transformation efficiency.
steps.expected_result: A count of colonies indicating transformation efficiency.

steps.title: Design donor DNAs
steps.instruction: Design donor DNAs for gene deletions based on target gene sequences.
steps.expected_result: A set of designed donor DNAs ready for testing.

steps.title: Test donor DNA efficiency
steps.instruction: Test the efficiency of the designed donor DNAs in E. coli for gene deletions.
steps.expected_result: Data on the efficiency of donor DNAs for gene deletions.

steps.title: Perform colony PCR
steps.instruction: Conduct PCR on selected colonies to verify gene deletions.
steps.expected_result: PCR products indicating successful gene deletions.

steps.title: Analyze PCR results
steps.instruction: Analyze PCR products through gel electrophoresis to confirm gene deletions.
steps.expected_result: Gel images showing the presence or absence of gene deletions.

steps.title: Construct pCasRed plasmid
steps.instruction: Follow the protocol to construct the pCasRed plasmid.
steps.expected_result: Successfully constructed pCasRed plasmid.

steps.title: Construct pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmid
steps.instruction: Follow the protocol to construct the pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmid.
steps.expected_result: Successfully constructed pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmid.

steps.title: Identify target genes
steps.instruction: Use bioinformatics tools to identify target genes with suitable PAM sequences.
steps.expected_result: List of target genes with identified PAM sequences.

steps.title: Clone gDNAs into pCRISPR
steps.instruction: Follow the cloning protocol to insert selected gDNAs into pCRISPR plasmids.
steps.expected_result: Recombinant pCRISPR plasmids containing gDNAs.

steps.title: Compare transformation efficiencies
steps.instruction: Analyze and compare the transformation efficiencies of pCRISPR-gDNA plasmids with the empty vector.
steps.expected_result: Data comparing transformation efficiencies.

steps.title: Perform sequencing analysis
steps.instruction: Sequence the PCR products from selected colonies to confirm mutations.
steps.expected_result: Sequencing data confirming the presence of desired mutations.

steps.title: Randomly analyze clones
steps.instruction: Select and analyze ten random clones from transformations using PCR and sequencing.
steps.expected_result: Analysis results of the selected clones.

steps.title: Investigate gene inactivation parameters
steps.instruction: Analyze the effects of dDNA length and concentration on gene inactivation efficiency.
steps.expected_result: Data on the impact of dDNA parameters on gene inactivation.

steps.title: Formulate PLX5622 chow
steps.instruction: Prepare the PLX5622 chow by mixing the appropriate amount of PLX5622 with standard chow.
steps.expected_result: PLX5622 chow is ready for feeding to mice.

steps.title: Formulate control chow
steps.instruction: Prepare the control chow by mixing standard chow without PLX5622.
steps.expected_result: Control chow is ready for feeding to mice.

steps.title: Acquire C57BL/6J mice
steps.instruction: Purchase C57BL/6J male mice from a reputable supplier.
steps.expected_result: C57BL/6J male mice are acquired and ready for breeding.

steps.title: Breed mice
steps.instruction: Breed the acquired C57BL/6J male mice to generate CX3CR1+/GFP/CCR2+/RFP animals.

steps.expected_result: Mice are treated with the designated chow for the specified duration.

steps.expected_result: Mice are successfully anesthetized and ready for irradiation.

steps.title: Perform cranial irradiation
steps.instruction: Deliver a total dose of 10 Gy of cranial irradiation to the anesthetized mice.

steps.title: Allow mice to explore

steps.expected_result: Mice explore the arena and objects for memory assessment.

steps.title: Set up maze for delayed matching-to-place test
steps.instruction: Prepare the maze for the delayed matching-to-place test.

steps.title: Conduct delayed matching-to-place test
steps.instruction: Place the mice in the maze and conduct the delayed matching-to-place test.
steps.expected_result: Spatial working memory is assessed in the mice.

steps.title: Prepare objects for metric distance test
steps.instruction: Select and arrange objects at varying distances for the metric distance test.

steps.title: Conduct metric distance test

steps.expected_result: Hippocampal function is measured based on mouse interactions.

steps.title: Euthanize mice
steps.instruction: Perfuse the mice and dissociate brain samples for flow cytometry analysis.

steps.title: Prepare brain hemispheres for Golgi staining

steps.expected_result: Brain hemispheres are ready for staining.

steps.title: Prepare NGM plates
steps.instruction: Pour NGM agar media into Petri dishes and allow to set for 2 days.
steps.expected_result: NGM plates are ready for seeding with E. coli.

steps.title: Seed plates with E. coli
steps.instruction: Seed the prepared NGM plates with E. coli OP50 and incubate overnight at 37°C.
steps.expected_result: E. coli is grown on NGM plates, ready for worm culture.

steps.title: Maintain worm cultures
steps.instruction: Pick L4 stage worms and transfer them to the NGM plates for culture at 20°C.
steps.expected_result: Worms are cultured on NGM plates for live imaging experiments.

steps.title: Set up microirradiation parameters
steps.instruction: Open MetaMorph and set up the MicroPoint Targeted Illumination parameters for microirradiation.
steps.expected_result: Microirradiation parameters are configured for the experiment.

steps.title: Microirradiate target nuclei
steps.instruction: Select target nuclei and initiate microirradiation using the configured settings.
steps.expected_result: Target nuclei are microirradiated as per the specified parameters.

steps.title: Prepare for live imaging
steps.instruction: Set up the glass bottom dish with worms and agarose pad for live imaging.
steps.expected_result: Worms are prepared and ready for imaging under the microscope.

steps.title: Capture live imaging data
steps.instruction: Use MetaMorph to capture images of the live worms at specified intervals.
steps.expected_result: Live imaging data of microirradiated worms is collected.

steps.title: Dissect worms
steps.instruction: Remove the agarose pad and transfer worms to a suitable medium for dissection.
steps.expected_result: Worms are prepared for dissection to extract gonads.

steps.title: Fix and stain gonads
steps.instruction: Fix the dissected gonads and prepare them for staining.
steps.expected_result: Gonads are fixed and ready for immunofluorescent staining.

steps.title: Perform immunofluorescent staining
steps.instruction: Stain the fixed gonads with specific antibodies to visualize proteins of interest.
steps.expected_result: Gonads are stained and ready for imaging analysis.

steps.title: Set up imaging parameters
steps.instruction: Configure the Leica Inverted Microscope and MetaMorph for imaging live worms.
steps.expected_result: Imaging parameters are set for optimal fluorescence capture.

steps.title: Image live worms
steps.instruction: Capture images of live worms using the configured microscope setup.
steps.expected_result: Images of live worms are obtained for analysis.

steps.title: Create time series project
steps.instruction: Set the time interval and duration for capturing images of microirradiated worms.
steps.expected_result: Time series project parameters are established for imaging.

steps.title: Acquire time-lapse images
steps.instruction: Initiate the time-lapse imaging process to capture images at specified intervals.
steps.expected_result: Time-lapse images of microirradiated worms are collected.

steps.title: Acquire mice
steps.instruction: Obtain male 3-month old BALB/cARC and C57BL/6JARC mice from a certified supplier.
steps.expected_result: Mice are acquired and ready for housing.

steps.title: House mice
steps.instruction: Place the acquired mice in groups of four in ventilated cages with controlled light and temperature.
steps.expected_result: Mice are housed in appropriate conditions.

steps.title: Implement food restriction
steps.instruction: Establish a food restriction protocol to maintain mice at 90% of their free-feeding body weight.
steps.expected_result: Mice are on a food restriction protocol.

steps.title: Provide daily food
steps.instruction: Provide food daily in small pieces to the mice.
steps.expected_result: Mice receive daily food in controlled portions.

steps.title: Prepare operant chambers
steps.instruction: Set up the operant chambers with touchscreens and ensure they are clean and functional.
steps.expected_result: Operant chambers are ready for use.

steps.title: Prime reward lines
steps.instruction: Prime the reward lines with fresh strawberry milk.
steps.expected_result: Reward lines are prepared for the training sessions.

steps.title: Conduct pre-training stages
steps.instruction: Implement the pre-training stages, starting with habituation and progressing through each task step.
steps.expected_result: Mice complete all pre-training stages successfully.

steps.title: Monitor training progress
steps.instruction: Track the performance of mice during each training stage and determine when they meet criteria to advance.
steps.expected_result: Mice are evaluated and advanced through training stages as appropriate.

steps.title: Conduct visual discrimination task
steps.instruction: Test mice on the visual discrimination task by presenting two stimuli and recording their responses.
steps.expected_result: Performance data from the visual discrimination task is collected.

steps.title: Acclimate mice to testing room
steps.instruction: Place the home cages of mice inside the testing room for at least 30 minutes before testing sessions.
steps.expected_result: Mice are habituated to the testing environment.

steps.title: Perform reversal learning task
steps.instruction: Switch the reward contingency for the previously unrewarded stimulus and test until criteria are met.
steps.expected_result: Mice complete the reversal learning task and performance is recorded.

steps.title: Analyze touchscreen performance
steps.instruction: Collect and analyze data on trials completed, response types, and other performance metrics.
steps.expected_result: Touchscreen performance metrics are analyzed and documented.

steps.title: Set up Open Field chambers
steps.instruction: Prepare square Perspex chambers with infrared beams for tracking locomotor activity and clean them with 70% ethanol.
steps.expected_result: Open Field setup is ready for testing.

steps.title: Conduct Open Field Test
steps.instruction: Place mice individually in the prepared chambers and record their locomotor activity over a 30-minute session.
steps.expected_result: Locomotor activity data is collected from the Open Field Test.

steps.title: Maintain DT40 cell lines
steps.instruction: Culture DT40, Non-KI(B), KI(B), and KI(MΦ) cell lines under appropriate conditions as previously described.
steps.expected_result: Healthy and actively dividing cell lines ready for experimentation.

steps.title: Subculture cells
steps.instruction: Subculture the DT40, Non-KI(B), KI(B), and KI(MΦ) cells as needed to maintain optimal growth conditions.
steps.expected_result: Cells are maintained at the appropriate density and health for subsequent experiments.

steps.title: Prepare chromatin from cells
steps.instruction: Crosslink cells with formaldehyde and prepare chromatin as described in the protocol.
steps.expected_result: Sonicated chromatin ready for immunoprecipitation.

steps.title: Sonicate chromatin
steps.instruction: Sonicate the prepared chromatin using an ultrasonic disruptor according to the specified conditions.
steps.expected_result: Fragmented chromatin with an average length of about 2 kbp.

steps.title: Perform immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: Add fragmented chromatin to Dynabeads conjugated with normal mouse IgG and incubate.
steps.expected_result: Cleared supernatant ready for the next step in the enChIP procedure.

steps.title: Add recombinant CRISPR RNPs
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared supernatant to Dynabeads conjugated with recombinant CRISPR RNPs and incubate.
steps.expected_result: Dynabeads with bound chromatin ready for elution.

steps.title: Purify DNA
steps.instruction: Elute DNA from the Dynabeads and purify using the ChIP DNA Clean and Concentrator kit.
steps.expected_result: Purified DNA samples ready for library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare NGS libraries
steps.instruction: Use the TruSeq ChIP Sample Prep Kit to prepare NGS libraries from the purified DNA samples.
steps.expected_result: NGS libraries ready for sequencing.

steps.title: Sequence DNA libraries
steps.instruction: Subject the prepared DNA libraries to sequencing using the HiSeq 2500 system.
steps.expected_result: Sequenced data files generated for analysis.

steps.title: Analyze NGS data
steps.instruction: Map the sequenced data onto the reference genome and detect narrow peaks using MACS2.
steps.expected_result: Identified genomic regions of interest based on peak detection.

steps.title: Clone target sequences
steps.instruction: Clone double-stranded DNA encoding target sequences downstream of the U6 promoter in a suitable vector.
steps.expected_result: sgRNA expression plasmids ready for transfection.

steps.title: Transfect DT40 cells
steps.instruction: Electroporate DT40 cells with Cas9 and sgRNA plasmids according to the established protocol.
steps.expected_result: Transfected DT40 cells ready for sorting.

steps.title: Sort GFP-positive cells
steps.instruction: Sort and expand GFP-positive cells one day after transfection using flow cytometry.
steps.expected_result: Enriched population of GFP-positive cells for further analysis.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from sorted cells for genotyping PCR.
steps.expected_result: Genomic DNA samples ready for PCR amplification.

steps.title: Perform RT-PCR
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from cells and perform quantitative RT-PCR as described in the protocol.
steps.expected_result: Quantitative data on gene expression levels.

steps.title: Conduct ChIP assays
steps.instruction: Perform ChIP assays with DT40 cells using specific antibodies and analyze with real-time PCR.
steps.expected_result: Data on protein-DNA interactions in the context of chromatin.

steps.title: Prepare DSS Treatment
steps.instruction: Prepare a 3% DSS solution in drinking water for C57BL/6 mice.
steps.expected_result: DSS solution is ready for administration to mice.

steps.title: Administer DSS to Mice
steps.instruction: Provide the 3% DSS solution to C57BL/6 mice for 7 days.
steps.expected_result: Mice have consumed DSS for the specified duration.

steps.title: Sacrifice Mice
steps.instruction: Sacrifice the mice after the treatment period for tissue collection.
steps.expected_result: Mice are sacrificed and ready for tissue collection.

steps.title: Isolate RNA from Tissues
steps.instruction: Use TRIzol according to the manufacturer's instructions to isolate total RNA from proximal colon tissues.
steps.expected_result: Total RNA is extracted and in solution.

steps.title: Prepare Lithium Chloride Solution
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 volume of 8M LiCl solution to the RNA solution.
steps.expected_result: LiCl is mixed with RNA solution for purification.

steps.title: Incubate on Ice
steps.instruction: Mix the solution well and incubate on ice for 2 hours.
steps.expected_result: RNA is precipitated with LiCl.

steps.title: Centrifuge the Mixture
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 14,000× g for 30 minutes at 4°C.
steps.expected_result: RNA pellet is formed at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Dissolve RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and dissolve the RNA pellet in RNase-free water.
steps.expected_result: RNA pellet is dissolved in water.

steps.title: Repeat Lithium Chloride Precipitation
steps.instruction: Repeat the precipitation process with 0.1 volume of LiCl, mix, incubate, centrifuge, and dissolve the pellet again.
steps.expected_result: RNA is further purified.

steps.title: Add Sodium Acetate and Ethanol
steps.instruction: Add sodium acetate and prechilled ethanol to the RNA solution and incubate at -20°C.
steps.expected_result: RNA is precipitated with sodium acetate and ethanol.

steps.title: Centrifuge to Collect RNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 14,000× g for 30 minutes at 4°C.
steps.expected_result: RNA pellet is formed again.

steps.title: Wash RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet with prechilled 70% ethanol and centrifuge.
steps.expected_result: RNA pellet is washed and ready for drying.

steps.title: Air Dry RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Let the RNA pellet air dry at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: RNA pellet is dried and ready for dissolution.

steps.title: Dissolve RNA in Water
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried RNA pellet in RNase-free water.
steps.expected_result: RNA is now in solution for further analysis.

steps.title: Quantify RNA Yield
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance peak at 260 nm and calculate the 260/280 nm ratio.
steps.expected_result: RNA yield and purity are determined.

steps.title: Prepare for cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Use the quantified RNA for cDNA synthesis and qPCR according to standard protocols.
steps.expected_result: RNA is ready for cDNA synthesis and qPCR.

steps.title: Collect synovial fluid
steps.instruction: Obtain synovial fluid from a patient with anti-CCP-positive RA.
steps.expected_result: Synovial fluid is collected and ready for processing.

steps.title: Process synovial fluid
steps.instruction: Process the collected synovial fluid to isolate plasma cells using the fluorescent foci method.
steps.expected_result: Plasma cells are isolated from the synovial fluid.

steps.title: Prepare blood sample
steps.instruction: Collect peripheral blood from RA patients for B cell sorting.
steps.expected_result: Peripheral blood samples are ready for flow cytometry.

steps.title: Sort B cells
steps.instruction: Sort single citrulline-specific B cells from the peripheral blood using an antigen-tetramer system via flow cytometry.
steps.expected_result: Single citrulline-specific B cells are sorted and collected.

steps.title: Coat ELISA plates
steps.instruction: Coat ELISA plates with citrulline- and arginine-containing peptides.
steps.expected_result: Plates are prepared for peptide ELISA.

steps.title: Add mAb to plates
steps.instruction: Dilute and add monoclonal antibodies to the coated plates at specified concentrations.
steps.expected_result: Monoclonal antibodies are added to the plates for binding assessment.

steps.title: Coat full-length proteins
steps.instruction: Coat ELISA plates with full-length proteins.
steps.expected_result: Plates are ready for blocking and incubation.

steps.title: Block and incubate plates
steps.instruction: Block the plates and incubate with citrullination buffer followed by ACPAs.
steps.expected_result: Plates are incubated and ready for detection.

steps.title: Synthesize peptides
steps.instruction: Synthesize peptides covering arginine and lysine sites of extracellular matrix proteins, including citrullinated and carbamylated variants.
steps.expected_result: A library of peptides is synthesized.

steps.title: Solubilize proteins
steps.instruction: Solubilize full-length proteins for Western blotting.
steps.expected_result: Proteins are prepared for electrophoresis.

steps.title: Electrophorese proteins
steps.instruction: Electrophorese the solubilized proteins on a gel.
steps.expected_result: Proteins are separated by size on the gel.

steps.title: Analyze sequences
steps.instruction: Analyze the 4 flanking amino acids from each posttranslational residue using the WebLogo application.
steps.expected_result: Consensus sequences are generated.

steps.title: Perform statistical tests
steps.instruction: Conduct statistical tests to determine differences in mutations and CDR3 characteristics.
steps.expected_result: Statistical analysis results are obtained.

steps.title: Synthesize in situ peptides
steps.instruction: Synthesize peptides covering arginine and lysine sites of extracellular matrix proteins in situ.
steps.expected_result: A large library of unique peptides is synthesized.

steps.title: Dilute mAb and samples
steps.instruction: Dilute monoclonal antibodies and samples of synovial fluid and serum to specified concentrations.
steps.expected_result: Diluted mAb and samples are ready for analysis.

steps.title: Scan for reactivity
steps.instruction: Perform scanning to detect citrulline and homocitrulline reactivity with mAb at high resolution.
steps.expected_result: Reactivity data is obtained.

steps.title: Analyze peptide sequences
steps.instruction: Analyze the flanking amino acids of posttranslational residues to generate consensus sequences.
steps.expected_result: Consensus sequences are generated.

steps.title: Seed cells in flasks
steps.instruction: Seed approximately one million MCF-7 cells in each of two T-75 flasks.
steps.expected_result: Cells are seeded and ready to grow.

steps.title: Grow cells to confluency
steps.instruction: Grow cells in complete medium at 37°C and 5% CO2 until they reach 60-70% confluency.
steps.expected_result: Cells are at the desired confluency for further treatment.

steps.title: Wash cells
steps.instruction: Wash cells briefly with pre-warmed DMEM or PBS.
steps.expected_result: Cells are washed and ready for medium replacement.

steps.title: Add MEGM to cells
steps.instruction: Add 10 ml of pre-warmed MEGM to both flasks and grow for 24 hours.
steps.expected_result: Cells are treated with MEGM for 24 hours.

steps.title: Prepare control and RI-treated flasks
steps.instruction: Wash cells again with pre-warmed MEGM, then add 10 ml of MEGM to the control flask and 10 ml of MEGM plus 80U of murine RNase inhibitor to the RI-treated flask.
steps.expected_result: Control and RI-treated flasks are prepared for further incubation.

steps.title: Aspirate conditioned medium
steps.instruction: Aspirate cell-conditioned medium from both flasks and transfer to nuclease-free Falcon conical tubes.
steps.expected_result: Cell-conditioned medium is collected for further processing.

steps.title: Spin down cells
steps.instruction: Spin down cells at 800× g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: Cells are pelleted and ready for lysis.

steps.title: Lyse cells
steps.instruction: Lyse cells in the flasks with 2 ml of Trizol, incubate for 5 minutes, then store at -20°C.
steps.expected_result: Cells are lysed and stored for RNA extraction.

steps.title: Thaw supernatants
steps.instruction: Thaw the tubes containing the supernatants from the previous step in a water bath at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: Supernatants are thawed and ready for further processing.

steps.title: Add RNase inhibitor
steps.instruction: Add 1 µl of murine RNase inhibitor to the RI-treated sample.
steps.expected_result: RNase inhibitor is added to prevent RNA degradation.

steps.title: Centrifuge supernatants
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples at 2,000× g for 20 minutes at 4°C to remove precipitates.
steps.expected_result: Supernatants are clarified and ready for ultracentrifugation.

steps.title: Prepare ultracentrifugation tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatants to ultraclear ultracentrifugation tubes and adjust the volume with ice-cold PBS if necessary.
steps.expected_result: Samples are prepared for ultracentrifugation.

steps.title: Run ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in the ultracentrifuge and run at 100,000× g for 2.5 hours at 4°C.
steps.expected_result: Ultracentrifugation is completed, and supernatants are ready for collection.

steps.title: Transfer supernatants
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatants from the ultracentrifugation to new tubes and keep on ice.
steps.expected_result: Supernatants are collected and chilled for concentration.

steps.title: Concentrate samples
steps.instruction: Concentrate the supernatants to 500 µl by ultrafiltration at 4°C.
steps.expected_result: Samples are concentrated and ready for size exclusion chromatography.

steps.title: Prepare FPLC system
steps.instruction: Filter and degas ultrapure water and PBS, then equilibrate the Superdex 200 column in PBS.
steps.expected_result: FPLC system is prepared for chromatography.

steps.title: Inject samples into column
steps.instruction: Spin the concentrated sample and inject 500 µl into the FPLC column.
steps.expected_result: Sample is injected and ready for separation.

steps.title: Run size exclusion chromatography
steps.instruction: Run the chromatography at a flow rate of 1 ml/min and monitor absorbance at 260 nm and 280 nm.
steps.expected_result: Chromatography is running and fractions are being collected.

steps.title: Collect fractions
steps.instruction: Collect fractions of 0.25 ml starting at least 2 ml before the void volume elution.
steps.expected_result: Fractions are collected for further analysis.

steps.title: Identify RNA-containing fractions
steps.instruction: Identify fractions where A260 > A280, corresponding to nucleic acids.
steps.expected_result: RNA-containing fractions are identified for purification.

steps.title: Add Trizol to fractions
steps.instruction: Add 750 µl of Trizol LS to each collected fraction and proceed with RNA extraction.
steps.expected_result: RNA is extracted from the fractions.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet in 9 µl of RNase-free water and check RNA concentration.
steps.expected_result: RNA concentration is measured and ready for sequencing.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing library
steps.instruction: Use the remaining RNA to prepare sequencing libraries using a small RNA kit.
steps.expected_result: Sequencing libraries are prepared for next-generation sequencing.

steps.title: Examine Morphology
steps.instruction: Use microscopy to examine and compare the morphology of iPS-DCregs, BM-DCregs, and conventional DCs.
steps.expected_result: Morphological characteristics of each DC type are documented.

steps.title: Conduct Allogeneic MLR
steps.instruction: Co-culture iPS-DCregs with allogeneic T cells under appropriate conditions.
steps.expected_result: Allogeneic MLR is established and ready for assessment.

steps.title: Prepare OVA for MLR

steps.title: Set Up OVA-specific MLR

steps.title: Prepare for Proliferation Lymph Node Assay

steps.expected_result: Mice are prepared for the proliferation lymph node assay.

steps.title: Conduct Proliferation Lymph Node Assay
steps.instruction: Inject OVA-pulsed BMDCs into the footpads of the mice and harvest popliteal lymph nodes after 3 days.
steps.expected_result: Popliteal lymph nodes are harvested and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Immunize CBA Mice with iPS-DCregs

steps.expected_result: CBA mice are immunized with iPS-DCregs.

steps.title: Isolate Spleens from Immunized Mice
steps.instruction: Harvest and isolate spleens from immunized CBA mice for further analysis.
steps.expected_result: Spleens from immunized mice are ready for Treg analysis.

steps.title: Inject iPS-DCregs Before Allograft
steps.instruction: Administer iPS-DCregs to CBA recipients prior to heart allograft transplantation.

steps.title: Monitor Allograft Survival
steps.instruction: Observe and record the survival time of allografts in recipients treated with iPS-DCregs.
steps.expected_result: Data on allograft survival is collected.

steps.title: Collect Allograft Samples
steps.instruction: Harvest allograft tissues from treated and control groups for analysis.
steps.expected_result: Allograft samples are ready for cytokine expression analysis.

steps.title: Administer TGF-β1 Blockage
steps.instruction: Apply TGF-β1 blockage treatment to CBA recipients prior to allograft transplantation.
steps.expected_result: TGF-β1 blockage is successfully administered.

steps.title: Conduct Antigen Uptake Tests
steps.instruction: Perform fluorescein isothiocyanate uptake tests on iPS-DCregs to assess antigen uptake ability.
steps.expected_result: Data on antigen uptake ability of iPS-DCregs is collected.

steps.expected_result: iPS-DCregs and T cells are ready for MLR setup.

steps.title: Conduct Allogeneic MLR
steps.instruction: Co-culture iPS-DCregs with allogeneic T cells under appropriate conditions.
steps.expected_result: Allogeneic MLR is established and ready for assessment.

steps.title: Obtain petunia plantlets
steps.instruction: Contact a flower farm to acquire rooted petunia plantlets of various lines.
steps.expected_result: Receive healthy rooted petunia plantlets ready for growth.

steps.title: Grow plants in greenhouse
steps.instruction: Place the obtained petunia plantlets in a greenhouse with controlled temperature and light conditions.
steps.expected_result: Plants grow optimally under specified conditions.

steps.title: Collect petunia flowers for analysis
steps.instruction: Remove all open flowers from the petunia plants to ensure uniform developmental stage.
steps.expected_result: All collected flowers are at anthesis, ready for further processing.

steps.title: Prepare flowers for protoplast isolation
steps.instruction: Select completely opened flowers and place them in a beaker with tap water.
steps.expected_result: Flowers are hydrated and ready for sterilization.

steps.title: Sterilize flowers
steps.instruction: Immerse flowers in hypochlorite solution, followed by rinsing in DDW.
steps.expected_result: Flowers are sterilized and free of contaminants.

steps.title: Prepare flowers for enzyme treatment
steps.instruction: Cut sterilized flowers to remove all organs except the corolla and pierce the corolla.
steps.expected_result: Prepared flower corollas are ready for enzyme treatment.

steps.title: Incubate flower halves
steps.instruction: Place flower halves in enzyme solution and incubate in the dark overnight.
steps.expected_result: Flower halves are enzymatically treated for protoplast isolation.

steps.title: Isolate protoplasts
steps.instruction: Shake the incubated plates and collect the liquid through a cell strainer into centrifuge tubes.
steps.expected_result: Protoplasts are isolated in the centrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Wash and centrifuge protoplasts
steps.instruction: Wash the Petri dishes with suspension buffer and centrifuge the tubes to separate protoplasts from debris.
steps.expected_result: Living protoplasts are floating above the debris layer.

steps.title: Prepare vacuoles from protoplasts
steps.instruction: Add Ficoll and vacuole buffer to the protoplasts and centrifuge to separate vacuoles.
steps.expected_result: Vacuoles are isolated and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Extract glycosylated compounds
steps.instruction: Transfer vacuole solution to Eppendorf tubes and add methyl alcohol for extraction.
steps.expected_result: Glycosylated compounds are extracted from vacuoles.

steps.title: Conduct GC-MS analysis
steps.instruction: Prepare hexane solution from extracted glycosides and perform GC-MS analysis.
steps.expected_result: Compounds are identified through GC-MS analysis.

steps.title: Perform statistical analyses
steps.instruction: Analyze the data obtained from GC-MS and other experiments for statistical significance.
steps.expected_result: Statistical results indicating significance of differences between treatments.

steps.title: Synthesize TO1-Dtb
steps.instruction: Follow established protocols to synthesize TO1-Dtb.
steps.expected_result: TO1-Dtb is synthesized and ready for use.

steps.title: Confirm TO1-Dtb identity
steps.instruction: Use mass spectrometry to confirm the identity of the synthesized TO1-Dtb.
steps.expected_result: Confirmation of TO1-Dtb identity by mass spectrometry.

steps.title: Synthesize TO3-Dtb
steps.instruction: Follow established protocols to synthesize TO3-Dtb.
steps.expected_result: TO3-Dtb is synthesized and ready for use.

steps.title: Confirm TO3-Dtb identity
steps.instruction: Use mass spectrometry to confirm the identity of the synthesized TO3-Dtb.
steps.expected_result: Confirmation of TO3-Dtb identity by mass spectrometry.

steps.title: Re-suspend streptavidin agarose beads
steps.instruction: Carefully re-suspend streptavidin agarose bead slurry by gentle agitation.
steps.expected_result: Streptavidin agarose beads are evenly re-suspended.

steps.title: Wash streptavidin agarose beads
steps.instruction: Wash 700 μl of streptavidin agarose beads twice with 1 ml Buffer A at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: Beads are washed and ready for derivatization.

steps.title: Incubate beads with TO1-Dtb
steps.instruction: Incubate washed beads with 6 nanomoles of TO1-Dtb in HK buffer for 15 minutes.
steps.expected_result: Beads are derivatized with TO1-Dtb.

steps.title: Wash unbound TO1-Dtb
steps.instruction: Wash the beads with HK buffer to remove any residual unbound TO1-Dtb.
steps.expected_result: Beads are ready for use in purification.

steps.title: Transform U1-M gene into yeast strain
steps.instruction: Introduce the U1-M gene into the yeast strain using transformation protocols.
steps.expected_result: Yeast strain is transformed with U1-M gene.

steps.title: Select transformants
steps.instruction: Select transformed yeast colonies on appropriate media.
steps.expected_result: Transformed yeast colonies are identified.

steps.title: Prepare whole-cell extracts
steps.instruction: Prepare whole-cell extracts from the selected yeast transformants.
steps.expected_result: Whole-cell extracts are ready for labeling.

steps.title: Label yeast extracts with SNAP-Surface 549
steps.instruction: Incubate yeast whole-cell extracts with SNAP-Surface 549 under specified conditions.
steps.expected_result: Yeast extracts are fluorescently tagged.

steps.title: Incubate extracts with TO1-Dtb beads
steps.instruction: Incubate yeast extracts with TO1-Dtb beads to pull down U1M-associated snRNPs.
steps.expected_result: U1M-associated snRNPs are bound to the beads.

steps.title: Wash beads
steps.instruction: Wash the beads to remove unbound materials.
steps.expected_result: Beads contain purified U1M-associated snRNPs.

steps.title: Elute snRNPs using biotin
steps.instruction: Elute snRNPs from the beads using biotin elution buffer.
steps.expected_result: SnRNPs are eluted and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Perform reverse transcription
steps.instruction: Conduct reverse transcription on RNA samples from the eluted snRNPs.
steps.expected_result: cDNA is synthesized from RNA samples.

steps.title: Analyze RNA using denaturing PAGE
steps.instruction: Analyze the reverse-transcribed RNA using denaturing polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis.
steps.expected_result: RNA integrity and expression levels are assessed.

steps.title: Clone 6S RDM plasmid
steps.instruction: Clone the 6S RDM plasmid with specific mutations into the pEcoli-Cterm-6xHN plasmid.
steps.expected_result: p6SRDM_T7 plasmid is constructed.

steps.title: Transform E. coli with p6SRDM_T7
steps.instruction: Introduce the p6SRDM_T7 plasmid into E. coli using transformation protocols.
steps.expected_result: E. coli is transformed with p6SRDM_T7.

steps.title: Grow cultures
steps.instruction: Grow transformed E. coli cultures under appropriate growth conditions.
steps.expected_result: E. coli cultures are ready for RNA transcription.

steps.title: Induce RNA transcription
steps.instruction: Induce transcription of RNA from the p6SRDM_T7 plasmid in E. coli.
steps.expected_result: 6S RDM RNA is produced.

steps.title: Incubate E. coli extract with TO1-Dtb beads
steps.instruction: Incubate E. coli native extract with TO1-Dtb beads to pull down RNP complexes.
steps.expected_result: RNP complexes are bound to the beads.

steps.title: Wash beads
steps.instruction: Wash the beads to remove unbound materials.
steps.expected_result: Beads contain purified RNP complexes.

steps.title: Elute RNP complexes using biotin
steps.instruction: Elute RNP complexes from the beads using biotin elution buffer.
steps.expected_result: RNP complexes are eluted and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Load biotin eluate onto SEC column
steps.instruction: Load the biotin eluate onto a size exclusion chromatography (SEC) column.
steps.expected_result: Biotin eluate is ready for fractionation.

steps.title: Collect fractions
steps.instruction: Collect fractions from the SEC column for analysis.
steps.expected_result: Fractions are collected and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Analyze fractions by mass spectrometry
steps.instruction: Analyze collected fractions using mass spectrometry to identify proteins.
steps.expected_result: Proteins in the RNP complex are identified.

steps.title: Incubate RNA with TO3-Dtb and eGFP-HE
steps.instruction: Incubate RNA samples with TO3-Dtb and eGFP-HE under specified conditions.
steps.expected_result: RNA is labeled for imaging analysis.

steps.title: Perform gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run gel electrophoresis on the incubated RNA samples.
steps.expected_result: RNA bands are separated for imaging.

steps.title: Perform gel imaging
steps.instruction: Image the gel to visualize the labeled RNA.
steps.expected_result: Fluorescently tagged RNA is visualized.

steps.title: Extract Viral RNA
steps.instruction: Extract viral RNA from 140 μl of plasma using the QIAgen Viral RNA Mini Kit following the manufacturer's instructions.
steps.expected_result: Viral RNA is extracted and ready for elution.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the extracted RNA in 50 μl of nuclease-free water.
steps.expected_result: Eluted RNA is obtained for storage.

steps.title: Aliquot RNA
steps.instruction: Aliquot the eluted RNA into 25 μl per tube and store at -80 °C until use.
steps.expected_result: Aliquoted RNA samples are stored for future experiments.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR reaction mixes for constructing mutant pUC57-IN plasmids according to the specified protocol.
steps.expected_result: PCR reaction mixes are ready for amplification.

steps.title: Perform PCR
steps.instruction: Conduct PCR using the prepared mixes with specified cycling conditions.
steps.expected_result: PCR products are generated for further analysis.

steps.title: Electrophoresis of PCR Products
steps.instruction: Run 10 μl of the PCR product on a 1% agarose gel at a constant voltage for detection.
steps.expected_result: PCR products are visualized on the gel.

steps.title: Digest PCR Products
steps.instruction: Add DMT enzyme to the remaining PCR product, mix, and incubate for 1 hour.
steps.expected_result: PCR products are digested and ready for transformation.

steps.title: Transform Competent Cells
steps.instruction: Add the DMT digestion product to competent cells, incubate on ice, heat shock, and then recover in LB medium.
steps.expected_result: Competent cells are transformed with mutant plasmids.

steps.title: Culture Transformed Cells
steps.instruction: Spread transformed cells on an ampicillin plate and incubate overnight.
steps.expected_result: Colonies of transformed cells are grown on the plate.

steps.title: Verify Mutants
steps.instruction: Pick mono-clones and culture in LB medium, then extract plasmid DNA for Sanger sequencing.
steps.expected_result: Mutated plasmids are verified by sequencing.

steps.title: Prepare RT-LAMP Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: In a 96-well PCR plate, prepare the RT-LAMP reaction mix with RNA template and necessary reagents.
steps.expected_result: RT-LAMP reaction mix is ready for incubation.

steps.title: Incubate RT-LAMP Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform the RT-LAMP reaction at 62 °C for the specified duration.
steps.expected_result: RT-LAMP reaction is completed and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Prepare Serial Dilutions
steps.instruction: Create ten-fold serial dilutions of RNA from DENV stocks.
steps.expected_result: Diluted RNA samples are prepared for sensitivity testing.

steps.title: Determine Sensitivity
steps.instruction: Test the sensitivity and limit of detection (LOD) of the RT-LAMP assay using the diluted RNA samples.
steps.expected_result: Sensitivity and LOD of the assay are established.

steps.title: Collect Clinical Samples
steps.instruction: Obtain plasma samples from dengue-suspected patients for testing.
steps.expected_result: Clinical samples are ready for RT-LAMP evaluation.

steps.title: Evaluate RT-LAMP Performance
steps.instruction: Compare RT-LAMP results with NS1 antigen detection and RT-PCR assays.
steps.expected_result: Performance of the RT-LAMP assay is assessed.

steps.title: Prepare Colorimetric RT-LAMP Mix
steps.instruction: In an 8-tube PCR strip, prepare the colorimetric RT-LAMP reaction mix with indicators and primers.
steps.expected_result: Colorimetric RT-LAMP mix is ready for reaction.

steps.title: Conduct Colorimetric RT-LAMP Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform the colorimetric RT-LAMP reaction and observe color changes at specified time points.
steps.expected_result: Color changes indicating reaction progress are observed.

steps.title: Prepare overnight culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate a culture tube containing LB media and chloramphenicol with E. coli NEB5α and BL21(DE3) strains under sterile conditions.
steps.expected_result: A saturated overnight culture of E. coli strains.

steps.title: Incubate overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate the culture at 37°C and 250 RPM for approximately 16 hours.
steps.expected_result: Growth of E. coli strains in the culture.

steps.title: Plate transformants
steps.instruction: Plate the overnight culture on LB agar plates containing appropriate antibiotics.
steps.expected_result: Colonies of transformed E. coli on LB agar plates.

steps.title: Prepare cells for transformation
steps.instruction: Electroporate E. coli cells with plasmids under sterile conditions.
steps.expected_result: Transformed E. coli cells ready for recovery.

steps.title: Recover and select transformants
steps.instruction: Recover electroporated cells in SOC medium and plate on LB agar with antibiotics.
steps.expected_result: Colonies of transformed E. coli on selective media.

steps.title: Amplify DNA by PCR
steps.instruction: Use PCR to amplify the DNA fragments required for plasmid construction.
steps.expected_result: Amplified DNA fragments ready for assembly.

steps.title: Assemble plasmids
steps.instruction: Use Gibson assembly to construct plasmids from amplified DNA fragments.
steps.expected_result: Constructed plasmids ready for verification.

steps.title: Verify plasmids by sequencing
steps.instruction: Send constructed plasmids for sequencing to confirm correct assembly.
steps.expected_result: Sequencing results confirming plasmid integrity.

steps.title: Dilute overnight culture
steps.instruction: Dilute 1 ml of the overnight culture into fresh LB media with chloramphenicol under sterile conditions.
steps.expected_result: Diluted culture of E. coli for protein expression.

steps.title: Induce protein expression
steps.instruction: Add IPTG to the diluted culture and incubate under appropriate conditions.
steps.expected_result: Induced protein expression of MIG in E. coli.

steps.title: Assess intein splicing inhibition
steps.instruction: Analyze the effect of zinc on intein splicing after protein expression.
steps.expected_result: Data on intein splicing inhibition by zinc.

steps.title: Prepare for purification
steps.instruction: Harvest cells expressing DnaBi1 and resuspend in lysis buffer.
steps.expected_result: Cell suspension ready for lysis.

steps.title: Lyse cells
steps.instruction: Sonicate the cell suspension on ice to lyse the cells.
steps.expected_result: Lysate containing DnaBi1 proteins.

steps.title: Purify DnaBi1
steps.instruction: Use affinity and gel filtration chromatography to purify DnaBi1 from the lysate.
steps.expected_result: Purified DnaBi1 protein ready for crystallization.

steps.title: Set up hanging-drop vapor diffusion
steps.instruction: Prepare hanging-drop vapor diffusion setup with purified DnaBi1 and zinc.
steps.expected_result: Setup ready for crystal growth.

steps.title: Grow crystals
steps.instruction: Allow crystals to grow under appropriate conditions for X-ray diffraction.
steps.expected_result: DnaBi1-zinc crystals formed.

steps.title: Flash-cool crystals
steps.instruction: Flash-cool the grown crystals in liquid nitrogen.
steps.expected_result: Crystals preserved for diffraction data collection.

steps.title: Collect diffraction data
steps.instruction: Collect X-ray diffraction data at the synchrotron.
steps.expected_result: Diffraction data obtained for analysis.

steps.title: Grow KD constructs
steps.instruction: Grow all 16 KD constructs and their splicing-inactive counterparts on LB media.
steps.expected_result: Cultures of KD constructs ready for screening.

steps.title: Screen for splicing-dependent resistance
steps.instruction: Assess splicing-dependent and independent resistance on LB media with varying kanamycin concentrations.
steps.expected_result: Data on resistance profiles of KD constructs.

steps.title: Prepare M. smegmatis culture
steps.instruction: Grow M. smegmatis under appropriate conditions for spot titer assays.
steps.expected_result: Culture of M. smegmatis ready for assays.

steps.title: Perform spot titer assays
steps.instruction: Conduct spot titer assays using KD154 to evaluate resistance to kanamycin.
steps.expected_result: Results of spot titer assays indicating resistance levels.

steps.title: Express MIG in BL21(DE3)
steps.instruction: Grow BL21(DE3) cells and induce MIG expression with IPTG.
steps.expected_result: MIG expressed in BL21(DE3) cells.

steps.title: Assess zinc-mediated inhibition
steps.instruction: Evaluate the effect of zinc on intein splicing in M. smegmatis and M. leprae.
steps.expected_result: Data on zinc-mediated inhibition of intein splicing.

steps.title: Seed Cells
steps.instruction: Seed 20,000 synovial fibroblasts or human dermal fibroblasts in 150 µl complete growth medium in a 96-well imagelock plate.
steps.expected_result: Cells are seeded at the appropriate density to reach 95% confluence overnight.

steps.title: Counteract Evaporation
steps.instruction: Fill the outer wells of the plate with 300 µl PBS to minimize evaporation effects.
steps.expected_result: Outer wells are filled to prevent evaporation during cell growth.

steps.title: Incubate Cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37°C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2 overnight.
steps.expected_result: Cells grow and reach approximately 95% confluence.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells twice with 100 µl PBS using a multi-channel pipette.
steps.expected_result: Cells are washed and prepared for starvation.

steps.title: Starve Cells
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl FBS-free culture medium and incubate in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2 for 2 hours.
steps.expected_result: Cells are starved to deplete growth factors.

steps.title: Create Scratch
steps.instruction: Use the IncuCyte® Wound Maker to create homogenous scratches in the cell monolayer.
steps.expected_result: Uniform scratches are created in the cell layer for migration assessment.

steps.title: Discard Medium
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the medium without disturbing the scratches using a multi-channel pipette.
steps.expected_result: Medium is removed while preserving the integrity of the scratches.

steps.title: Add Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl of low-serum culture medium (2% FBS) containing experimental treatments to the wells.
steps.expected_result: Wells are treated with specified experimental conditions for migration assays.

steps.title: Setup IncuCyte Zoom Scan
steps.instruction: Place the 96-well imagelock plate in the IncuCyte Zoom and schedule scans for the experiment.
steps.expected_result: Scanning is scheduled to monitor cell migration over time.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Mass Spectrometry
steps.instruction: Collect and prepare whole cell lysates from both starved and non-starved FLS for mass spectrometry analysis.
steps.expected_result: Samples are ready for mass spectrometry to detect citrullination.

steps.title: Load Cell Lysates
steps.instruction: Load the prepared cell lysates onto SDS-PAGE gels for Western blot analysis.
steps.expected_result: Cell lysates are properly loaded for subsequent transfer to membranes.

steps.title: Transfer to Membranes
steps.instruction: Transfer the proteins from the SDS-PAGE gels to membranes for antibody incubation.
steps.expected_result: Proteins are successfully transferred to membranes for detection.

steps.title: Collect Cells for Flow Cytometry
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and prepare them for staining with antibodies for flow cytometry analysis.
steps.expected_result: Cells are collected and ready for antibody staining.

steps.title: Stain Cells
steps.instruction: Stain the collected cells with appropriate antibodies for flow cytometry.
steps.expected_result: Cells are stained and ready for analysis using a flow cytometer.

steps.title: Perform Statistical Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the collected data using appropriate statistical tests to determine significance.
steps.expected_result: Statistical analysis is completed to assess the significance of the results.

steps.title: Analyze Data with Statistical Tests
steps.instruction: Apply either the Kruskal-Wallis test followed by Dunn’s multiple comparison test or two-way ANOVA followed by Tukey’s post hoc test to the data.
steps.expected_result: Data analysis is performed using the specified statistical tests.

steps.title: Prepare Arabidopsis seeds
steps.instruction: Place Arabidopsis seeds in 1.5mL tubes.
steps.expected_result: Seeds are ready for sterilization.

steps.title: Sterilize seeds
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 70% ethanol and wash the seeds for 1 minute.
steps.expected_result: Seeds are sterilized.

steps.title: Wash seeds
steps.instruction: Remove the ethanol solution and add 1 mL of H2O, 10 µL of 10% Tween 20, and 50 µL of sodium hypochlorite solution, then mix using a vortex mixer.
steps.expected_result: Seeds are treated with the washing solution.

steps.title: Invert tubes
steps.instruction: Wash the seeds for 15 minutes by gently inverting the tubes.
steps.expected_result: Seeds are thoroughly washed.

steps.title: Rinse seeds
steps.instruction: Remove the solution and rinse the seeds five times with sterilized water.
steps.expected_result: Seeds are rinsed and ready for sowing.

steps.title: Sow seeds
steps.instruction: Sow the seeds in plastic Petri dishes with culture media.
steps.expected_result: Seeds are sown in culture media.

steps.title: Incubate seeds
steps.instruction: Incubate at 4°C for three days.
steps.expected_result: Seeds are cold-stratified.

steps.title: Grow seedlings in darkness
steps.instruction: Cover the dishes with aluminum foil and incubate at 23°C for five days.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings are etiolated with elongated hypocotyls.

steps.title: Expose seedlings to light
steps.instruction: Remove the aluminum foil and grow the seedlings under a 10h light/14h dark cycle at 23°C for five days.
steps.expected_result: Cotyledons become green.

steps.title: Transfer seedlings
steps.instruction: Transfer the Arabidopsis seedlings to plastic square dishes with culture media with or without 1% sucrose.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings are transferred to new dishes.

steps.title: Incubate seedlings vertically
steps.instruction: Place the dishes vertically and incubate the plants under a 10h light/14h dark cycle at 23°C for 14 days.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings are grown for 14 days.

steps.title: Cut hypocotyls
steps.instruction: Cut the hypocotyls with a razor blade.
steps.expected_result: Hypocotyls are cut and ready for exudate collection.

steps.title: Collect xylem exudates
steps.instruction: Wipe the first droplets with soft paper to avoid contamination and collect the droplets with a micropipette.
steps.expected_result: Xylem exudates are collected.

steps.title: Store exudates
steps.instruction: Store the collected exudates at -80°C.
steps.expected_result: Xylem exudates are stored for future analysis.

steps.title: Prepare samples for analysis
steps.instruction: Thaw the stored xylem exudates at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: Samples are ready for analysis.

steps.title: Set up nano-LC–MS/MS
steps.instruction: Configure the nano-liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry system according to standard protocols.
steps.expected_result: System is set up for analysis.

steps.title: Inject samples
steps.instruction: Inject the prepared xylem exudate samples into the nano-LC–MS/MS system.
steps.expected_result: Samples are injected and being analyzed.

steps.title: Collect data
steps.instruction: Collect and record the data generated from the nano-LC–MS/MS analysis.
steps.expected_result: Data from the analysis is collected.

steps.title: Prepare DCMU treatment
steps.instruction: Prepare a solution of DCMU for treatment.
steps.expected_result: DCMU solution is ready for application.

steps.title: Treat plants with DCMU
steps.instruction: Apply the DCMU solution to the plants.
steps.expected_result: Plants are treated with DCMU.

steps.title: Expose plants to darkness
steps.instruction: Place the treated plants in darkness for the specified duration.
steps.expected_result: Plants are exposed to darkness.

steps.title: Collect plant samples
steps.instruction: Harvest roots and leaves from the plants for analysis.
steps.expected_result: Plant samples are collected.

steps.title: Prepare samples for sugar and starch analysis
steps.instruction: Process the collected samples to extract sugars and starches.
steps.expected_result: Samples are prepared for quantification.

steps.title: Quantify sugar and starch levels
steps.instruction: Use appropriate assays to measure sugar and starch contents in the samples.
steps.expected_result: Sugar and starch levels are quantified.

steps.title: Design CRISPR/Cas9 constructs
steps.instruction: Design the CRISPR/Cas9 constructs targeting cle2 and cle3 genes.
steps.expected_result: CRISPR constructs are designed.

steps.title: Transform plant cells
steps.instruction: Transform Arabidopsis cells with the CRISPR/Cas9 constructs.
steps.expected_result: Transformed cells are obtained.

steps.title: Select double mutants
steps.instruction: Screen for cle2cle3 double mutants among the transformed plants.
steps.expected_result: Double mutants are identified.

steps.title: Generate transgenic lines
steps.instruction: Create transgenic Arabidopsis lines expressing CLE2 ectopically.
steps.expected_result: Transgenic lines are generated.

steps.title: Analyze sucrose levels
steps.instruction: Measure sucrose levels in the transgenic lines.
steps.expected_result: Sucrose levels are analyzed.

steps.title: Prepare synthetic CLE2 peptide
steps.instruction: Synthesize the mature CLE2 peptide for application.
steps.expected_result: Synthetic CLE2 peptide is ready.

steps.title: Apply CLE2 peptide
steps.instruction: Transiently apply the synthetic CLE2 peptide to Arabidopsis rosette leaves.
steps.expected_result: CLE2 peptide is applied to the leaves.

steps.title: Prepare sucrose solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a sucrose solution for application to cle1-7 mutant plants.
steps.expected_result: Sucrose solution is ready.

steps.title: Apply sucrose to plants
steps.instruction: Apply the sucrose solution to the cle1-7 mutant plants.
steps.expected_result: Sucrose is applied to the plants.

steps.title: Prepare grafting materials
steps.instruction: Gather materials needed for grafting experiments.
steps.expected_result: Grafting materials are ready.

steps.title: Perform grafting
steps.instruction: Graft plants to study the effect of root genotype on SUC2 expression.
steps.expected_result: Plants are successfully grafted.

steps.title: Collect Arabidopsis xylem exudate
steps.instruction: Follow the steps outlined in T1 to gather xylem exudate from Arabidopsis plants.
steps.expected_result: Xylem exudate is collected from Arabidopsis.

steps.title: Treat plants with DCMU or darkness
steps.instruction: Apply DCMU or place plants in darkness as described in T3.
steps.expected_result: Plants are treated with DCMU or darkness.

steps.title: Prepare synthetic CLE2 peptide
steps.instruction: Synthesize the synthetic mature CLE2 peptide for application.
steps.expected_result: Synthetic CLE2 peptide is ready for application.

steps.title: Apply CLE2 peptide
steps.instruction: Transiently apply the synthetic mature CLE2 peptide to the rosette leaves of WT Arabidopsis plants.
steps.expected_result: CLE2 peptide is applied to the rosette leaves.

steps.title: Euthanize and Prepare Embryos
steps.instruction: Euthanize pregnant mice and prepare embryos by removing them from the uterus and placing them in sterile dissection medium on ice.
steps.expected_result: Embryos are prepared and stored in a sterile environment on ice.

steps.title: Isolate Brain Tissues
steps.instruction: Decapitate embryos, remove skin and skull, and isolate the brain tissues, specifically the hippocampus and cortex.
steps.expected_result: Hippocampus and cortex tissues are isolated and collected in a sterile Falcon tube.

steps.title: Wash and Disrupt Tissues
steps.instruction: Wash the isolated tissues with fresh dissection medium, then add disruption medium and mix.
steps.expected_result: Tissues are disrupted and prepared for cell suspension.

steps.title: Resuspend and Count Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in neuronal complete medium and count the cells using a counting chamber.
steps.expected_result: Cell concentration is determined and recorded.

steps.title: Store Neuronal Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in Neurostore medium and aliquot into cryovials for storage.
steps.expected_result: Neuronal cells are stored in cryovials at appropriate temperatures.

steps.title: Transduce Neurons
steps.instruction: Transduce neurons with viruses at DIV4 and treat with growth factors.
steps.expected_result: Neurons are successfully transduced and treated for further analysis.

steps.title: Conduct MTT Assay
steps.instruction: Perform the MTT assay on neuronal cultures to assess cell viability.
steps.expected_result: Viability data is obtained from the MTT assay.

steps.title: Wash Neurons
steps.instruction: Wash neuronal cultures to remove any residual media or reagents.
steps.expected_result: Neurons are clean and ready for lysis.

steps.title: Lyse Neurons
steps.instruction: Lysis of washed neurons is performed to prepare for protein analysis.
steps.expected_result: Cell lysate is obtained for subsequent analysis.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Western Blot
steps.instruction: Dilute lysate samples with Laemmli buffer and load onto SDS-PAGE gels.
steps.expected_result: Samples are prepared and loaded for Western blotting.

steps.title: Fix and Stain Neurons
steps.instruction: Fix neuronal cultures and apply staining protocols to visualize mitochondrial superoxide and synaptic markers.
steps.expected_result: Neurons are stained and ready for imaging.

steps.title: Record Electrophysiological Data
steps.instruction: Perform whole-cell recordings in voltage- and current-clamp modes to assess neuronal activity.
steps.expected_result: Electrophysiological data is collected for analysis.

steps.title: Analyze Data Statistically
steps.instruction: Log and analyze the collected data using appropriate statistical methods.
steps.expected_result: Statistical analysis results are obtained.

steps.title: Centrifuge Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 16,000 g for 20 minutes to clarify the sample.
steps.expected_result: Clarified lysate is obtained for further analysis.

steps.title: Measure Protein Concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the protein concentration of the lysate using a Bradford assay.
steps.expected_result: Protein concentration values are recorded.

steps.title: Load Samples for Western Blot
steps.instruction: Prepare and load diluted samples onto SDS-PAGE gels for Western blotting.
steps.expected_result: Samples are ready for electrophoresis.

steps.title: Apply Primary Antibodies
steps.instruction: Apply primary antibodies to the membrane in blocking buffer and incubate overnight.
steps.expected_result: Membranes are prepared for detection of target proteins.
